Title: Information Security Program Manager
Description:
**Key Responsibilities**

 Plan, lead and manage the end-to-end ISO/IEC 27001 program, including ISMS scope definition, timelines, budget, resources and stakeholder reporting.

 Review existing information security policies, standards, procedures and records to assess completeness and alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002.

 Examine current security practices and controls across people, processes and technology to evaluate how effectively they operate in practice.

 Conduct a detailed gap analysis against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements (Clauses 4–10 and Annex A controls) and produce a prioritized remediation roadmap.

 Develop and maintain the information security risk management methodology, and conduct periodic technical risk assessments of applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services and medical and clinical systems.

 Maintain the information security risk register and risk treatment plans, and track the implementation of treatments with risk and control owners.

 Coordinate periodic vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and configuration reviews, and ensure findings are risk-rated, remediated and verified.

 Establish and manage a CIS-based compliance program, adopting the CIS Critical Security Controls (v8) and CIS Benchmarks as secure configuration baselines for operating systems, databases, network devices, cloud platforms and applications.

 Conduct periodic CIS compliance assessments using automated scanning tools (e.g., CIS-CAT Pro, Tenable, Qualys), track compliance scores against agreed targets, and coordinate remediation or documented exceptions with system owners.

 Prepare and maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA) and the documentation required for the ISMS, including the ISMS scope, policy, objectives and supporting procedures.

 Assess information security risks of third parties and suppliers, and ensure appropriate security requirements are included in contracts.

 Establish and run the ISMS internal audit program and management reviews, and track

non conformities and corrective actions through to closure.

 Prepare CLIENT for Stage 1 and Stage 2 re-certification audits and ongoing surveillance audits, coordinate with the certification body, and lead the response to any findings.

 Define information security KPIs and metrics, and generate and present periodic (monthly and quarterly) reports covering risk posture, control effectiveness, vulnerability and remediation status, CIS compliance scores, security incidents, audit findings and awareness completion, to support management reviews and decision-making.

 Drive information security awareness and training so that staff understand their responsibilities within the ISMS.

 Ensure the ISMS aligns with CLIENT policies and applicable UAE and Dubai Government information security and data protection requirements, including the UAE Information Assurance Standards, Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) requirements and healthcare data regulations.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

 Support the implementation, maintenance and certification of the IT Service Management System (ISO/IEC 20000-1) and the Business Continuity Management System (ISO 22301), working closely with the IT Service Management and Business Continuity teams.

 Align ISMS controls with ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, capacity, availability and supplier management.

 Contribute to business impact analysis (BIA), the definition of recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) and continuity risk assessments for critical IT services and information assets.

 Support the development, review and testing of IT service continuity, disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and ensure lessons learned are captured and acted upon.

 Identify opportunities for an integrated management system across ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including shared policies, documentation, internal audits and management reviews.

 Support internal and external audits for ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including evidence preparation and follow-up of corrective actions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.

 [7–10]+ years of experience in information security, including at least [3] years leading ISMS, security risk or compliance programs.

 Proven track record of leading at least one ISO/IEC 27001 implementation or certification.

 In-depth knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27002 and ISO/IEC 27005, and of risk

assessment methodologies.

 Hands-on experience implementing and assessing the CIS Critical Security Controls and CIS Benchmarks, including the use of configuration compliance scanning tools.

 Solid technical understanding of networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, identity and access management, and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners).

 Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301; hands-on implementation or audit experience with these standards is a strong advantage.

 Familiarity with UAE and Dubai information security regulations and healthcare data protection requirements.

 Experience in healthcare or government environments is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

 ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer and/or Lead Auditor

 CISSP, CISM or CISA

 ISO/IEC 20000-1 and/or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (advantageous)

 CRISC or an equivalent risk management certification (advantageous)

 PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification

**Key Competencies**

 Program and change management

 Risk-based thinking and sound technical judgement

 Stakeholder management and ability to influence without direct authority

 Analytical thinking and attention to detail

 Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Arabic is an advantage)

 Facilitation, coaching and training delivery

Title: Assistant Manager - Pouching
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Assistant Manager – Pouching Department

**Department:**Production – Pouching  
**Reports To:**Production Manager / Plant Head

1. Job PurposeTo manage and control all pouching operations to achieve production targets, optimum machine utilization, required quality standards, on-time delivery, minimum wastage, and efficient manpower utilization while ensuring compliance with safety and company procedures.2. Key Responsibilities**A. Production Planning and Execution**

* Execute daily and monthly production plans as per customer requirements and delivery schedules.
* Ensure optimum utilization of pouching machines, manpower, and available resources.
* Monitor production output, machine speeds, efficiency, downtime, and order completion.
* Ensure timely changeovers, job preparation, and smooth production flow.
* Coordinate with Planning, Printing, Lamination, Slitting, QA, Maintenance, departments.
* Take corrective action to recover production losses and meet daily targets.

**B. Productivity and Cost Control**

* Achieve defined targets for output, productivity, machine utilization, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), where applicable.
* Minimize material wastage, start-up rejection, sealing defects, and pouching losses.
* Monitor production performance against established standards and identify improvement opportunities.
* Improve machine running speeds and reduce setup, changeover, and idle time.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase capacity and reduce conversion costs.

**C. Quality Management**

* Ensure production conforms to approved specifications, customer requirements, and quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters such as sealing temperature, pressure, dwell time, registration, dimensions, zipper alignment, gusset formation, and cutting accuracy, as applicable to the pouch type.
* Ensure first-piece approval and regular in-process quality checks.
* Prevent defects such as seal leakage, wrinkles, misregistration, poor cutting, contamination, and dimensional variation.
* Ensure traceability, correct material identification, and proper recording of production and quality data.
* Coordinate with QA to investigate non-conformities, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure rejected and non-conforming material is properly identified, segregated, and controlled.

**D. Manpower Management**

* Allocate operators and helpers according to machine loading and production priorities.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and operator performance.
* Develop operator skills through training, coaching, and competency assessments.
* Ensure proper shift handover and effective communication between shifts.
* Build a multi-skilled workforce to improve operational flexibility.

**E. Machine Maintenance and Performance**

* Coordinate with Maintenance to ensure preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor recurring breakdowns and implement measures to reduce downtime.
* Ensure machines, tools, sealing jaws, cutting systems, and other accessories are maintained in good working condition.
* Ensure proper machine settings, changeover practices, and equipment handling.
* Report technical issues and recommend improvements to enhance machine reliability.

**F. Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company safety rules, machine guarding, and lockout/tagout procedures where applicable.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping, and cleanliness throughout the department.
* Ensure safe handling of materials, tools, and equipment.
* Promote a safety-first culture and report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality, food-contact packaging, hygiene, and customer requirements.

**G. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily production and shift performance reports.
* Monitor output, efficiency, downtime, wastage, rejection, and manpower utilization.
* Ensure accurate recording of production data in ERP systems.
* Analyze performance gaps and submit action plans to the Production Manager.
* Maintain records of machine settings, quality checks, changeovers, downtime, and material reconciliation.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated against approved departmental targets for:

* Production output versus plan.
* Machine efficiency and utilization.
* Downtime and breakdown losses.
* Material wastage and rejection percentage.
* Quality defects and customer complaints.
* On-time order completion.
* Setup and changeover time.
* Manpower productivity and overtime control.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.
* Safety, housekeeping, and audit compliance.
* ERP data accuracy and timely reporting.
* Continuous improvement and cost reduction.

4. Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* 12-15 years of experience in pouching department experience; out of which 3 to 4 yrs as pouching in charge or AM pouching
* Experience in operating and managing pouching machines for different pouch formats, such as three-side seal, centre seal, stand-up pouch, zipper pouch, flat bottom 3 D pouch , quad pouch and other applicable formats.
* Knowledge of flexible packaging materials, laminates, sealing characteristics, pouch specifications, and defect analysis.
* Experience in production planning, manpower management, troubleshooting, quality control, and productivity improvement.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, production reporting, Excel, and root-cause analysis.

5. Required Competencies

* Strong production planning and execution skills.
* Leadership and manpower management.
* Analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Knowledge of pouching technology, process parameters and various pouching machine tools for all purposes.
* Focus on quality, productivity, waste reduction, and cost control.
* Effective coordination with cross-functional departments.
* Accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement mindset.

6. Authority and Accountability

* Allocate manpower and machines according to the approved production plan.
* Adjust machine settings within approved process specifications.
* Stop production when critical quality or safety issues are identified.
* Escalate material shortages, major breakdowns, quality deviations, and delivery risks.
* Recommend process improvements, training, and maintenance interventions.
* Accountable for departmental production performance, product quality, wastage, safety, and manpower utilization.

**Overall Accountability: To** ensure safe, efficient, cost-effective, and quality-compliant pouching operations while consistently achieving production and delivery targets.

Pay: AED7,500.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Project Manager-Electrical
Description:
Core Role and Responsibilities:

* Ensure all activities are executed in accordance with KAHRAMAA’s technical specifications,

HSE requirements, and all applicable Qatari laws and regulations.

* Prepare and maintain all mandatory reports and plans in accordance with KAHRAMAA

standards, including but not limited to Project Execution Plans, Risk Management Plans,

Emergency Response Plans, and electricity blackout restoration plans. Ensure these

documents clearly define resource mobilization procedures, communication protocols, and

escalation matrices. Submit periodic updates and maintain full readiness for audits and

emergency drills.

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of, and compliance with, all referenced national and

international standards.

* Guarantee that all staff and subcontractors are registered, certified, and authorized as

required by KAHRAMAA and Qatari law.

* Prepare, update, and implement detailed site work execution programs and Method

Statements, including a Work Breakdown Structure and resource plan, in line with

KAHRAMAA requirements.

* Plan, schedule, and monitor all contract activities and manpower, ensuring progress is

tracked and reported through weekly and monthly updates (including S-curves, histograms, and look-ahead schedules).

* Oversee the supply, installation, replacement, and maintenance of electricity meters,

ensuring seamless integration with KAHRAMAA systems.

* Attend and actively participate in KAHRAMAA progress meetings, emergency site meetings, and coordination meetings with Meter Section–CSD, contractors, telecom providers, government agencies, and other stakeholders.

* Ensure timely communication and alignment across all parties to prevent delays and

conflicts.

* Develop, implement, and maintain a Project Quality Plan (PQP), Method Statements,

Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), and calibration logs for all test equipment.

* Submit all QA/QC documentation, including NCRs, corrective actions, and audit reports, for KAHRAMAA review and approval.

Develop and enforce a comprehensive HSE Plan in compliance with KAHRAMAA

requirements, including risk assessments, emergency response, PPE, and incident

reporting.

Safeguard all customer and project-related information, including meter data, system

configurations, and reports, against unauthorized access or disclosure. Maintain secure

handling, storage, and transmission of sensitive data in accordance with KAHRAMAA

standards and applicable regulations.

* Maintain all HSE documentation, including audit and inspection reports, and ensure

compliance with all KAHRAMAA and national HSE requirements.

* Implement a serialized inventory management system for all meters and accessories, with

near real-time tracking and reporting to KAHRAMAA.

* Establish a warranty management framework for all meters and accessories, including

tracking of failures, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.

* Lead and coordinate the assigned team to ensure all activities are performed and executed

as expected.

* Take necessary corrective actions to fulfill contractual and operational requirements.

* Ensure complete and accurate documentation for all installations, replacements, and

maintenance activities in accordance with KAHRAMAA standards.

* Develop and execute strategies for revenue protection, ensuring accurate metering, billing

integrity, and prevention of energy theft or tampering.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation)

from a recognized university.

* Project Management certification (PMP or PRINCE2) is required.

* Minimum 15+ years overall experience in the utility domain as Project Manager, with at least

5 years in the metering domain.

* Strong knowledge of international standards, QA/QC practices, and HSE requirements.

* Fluent in English (written and spoken); computer literate with strong presentation skills.

* Availability for mobile communication during and outside office hours for emergency contact.

* Familiarity with installation and preventive/corrective/predictive/emergency maintenance

frameworks and utility infrastructure, including metering projects.

* Arabic language proficiency is preferred for effective customer and stakeholder

communication.

Pay: QAR15,000.00 - QAR20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Position Description:**

The Toronto Region Board of Trade is seeking a Senior Director, Information Technology for a 14-month contract to lead the Board's IT team. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, you will ensure the Board's systems remain secure, reliable and well-supported, and serve as a trusted technology partner across all levels of the organization. This role oversees IT operations, business applications, vendor partnerships, cybersecurity and in-flight technology initiatives within a Microsoft-centred environment that includes Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. * Maintains a strong understanding of the organization’s technology environment and remains actively involved in the execution and resolution of day-to-day technology matters.
* Identifies opportunities to improve technology effectiveness, reliability and user experience, with a focus on practical solutions appropriate for a 50-100-person organization.

* Provides service to all areas of the Board by applying business partner skills and a client service outlook.
* Allocates work effectively across the team and ensures appropriate coverage for operational priorities, projects and employee support.
* Documents key decisions and changes to support a smooth transition at the end of the contract.

* Manages the relationships with key technology partners, including the managed services providers; monitors performance and oversees renewals and negotiations.
* Leads vendor escalations and ensures unresolved service issues are addressed quickly and effectively.
* Maintains the Board's cybersecurity posture across Azure and Microsoft 365, including identity, access and data protection.
* Upholds IT policies, including the Board's AI use policy, and supports compliance with accessibility (AODA) and privacy requirements.

***IT Operations & Service Delivery***

* Oversees the reliable day-to-day operation of IT infrastructure and technology services at both the Board’s event space at 100 Queens Quay and corporate office at 21 Melinda, including network connectivity, Wi-Fi, end-user services, collaboration tools and telephony.

* Manages the IT operating calendar, including renewals, reviews and as needed event support.
* Maintains service levels and resolves escalated issues promptly.
* Oversees technology onboarding and offboarding, hardware and software provisioning, access management and equipment lifecycle requirements.

***Business Applications & Data***

* Oversees the Board's infrastructure including: CRM, marketing automation, finance, event management system, payments, website and related platforms.
* Works directly with business teams and vendors to troubleshoot issues, manage enhancements and ensure systems are configured to support operational requirements.
* Coordinates system upgrades, integrations, implementations and changes, ensuring appropriate testing, communication, documentation and employee support.
* Supports reporting and analytics through Power BI and champions low-code solutions on the Power Platform where they add value.
* Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows and improve productivity using existing technology.

**Your experience includes:**

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading IT teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong working knowledge of a Microsoft-centred environment, including Azure, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.
* Practical experience implementing or supporting AI tools and workflow automation, including technical deployment and employee adoption; experience with agentic AI solutions considered an asset.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure, connectivity, audiovisual systems and technology support across multiple locations, including corporate office and event environments.
* Proven experience managing managed service providers and external agencies, including contracts and performance.
* Solid grounding in cybersecurity practices for a cloud-first organization.
* Experience managing an IT budget and reporting to senior executives.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; experience explaining technical matters to partners at all levels.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with business units.
* Experience with Business Central, Power BI, ClickDimensions, CMS considered an asset.

**You’re often described as:**

* A steady, pragmatic leader who builds trust quickly with a new team
* A business partner first, able to translate organizational needs into practical technology solutions
* Highly organized and able to navigate competing priorities and deadlines
* A self-starter who can work independently from a structured handover
* A strong communicator, collaborative with colleagues from all levels and departments
* Security-minded, detail-oriented and accountable

**Working Conditions:**

* Full-time position, hybrid with 3-4 days in office.
* May require occasional evening and weekend work for system maintenance or emergencies.
* On-call availability for critical system issues.

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.
  
  
**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**
**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

Are you an experienced IT infrastructure professional with a strong background in cloud technologies, infrastructure design and service delivery?

WSIB is looking for a
**Solution Manager, Infrastructure Services**
to help oversee and optimize our Network, Cloud and Data Center infrastructure services.

In this role, you'll combine your technical expertise with strategic oversight to support infrastructure operations, lead complex technology initiatives and collaborate with internal teams and external service providers to deliver reliable, secure and efficient IT solutions.

This is a technical leadership role without direct people management responsibilities, offering the opportunity to influence infrastructure strategy, drive continuous improvement and contribute to the modernization of WSIB's technology environment.

**What You'll Do**

As a Solution Manager, Infrastructure Services, you will:

* **Oversee Infrastructure Operations:**
  Support the delivery, performance and reliability of Network, Cloud and Data Center services, including incident resolution, infrastructure changes and operational risk management.
* **Lead Technology Initiatives:**
  Coordinate complex infrastructure projects, from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, deployment and operational readiness.
* **Drive Infrastructure Strategy:**
  Contribute to short- and long-term technology planning, identifying opportunities for modernization, automation and service optimization.
* **Manage Vendor Relationships:**
  Oversee external service providers, ensuring contractual commitments, service level agreements, project timelines and quality standards are met.
* **Support Financial & Resource Planning:**
  Contribute to budgets, financial forecasts, procurement activities and infrastructure capacity planning.
* **Ensure Compliance & Risk Management:**
  Support infrastructure governance, audits, security standards and proactive risk mitigation.
* **Collaborate & Provide Technical Guidance:**
  Work closely with IT teams, business stakeholders and external partners to resolve challenges, share expertise and support organizational priorities.

**Education Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and/or Information Technology (or equivalent education and work experience).
* Industry relevant education or certificates for design, implementation and management of infrastructure environment (e.g. ITIL, certificates from leading infrastructure product vendors such as Microsoft, Cisco, Red Hat, AWS, Google, IBM, Oracle).

**Experience Requirements**

**Minimum Experience Required:**

* 9+ years of work experience related to IT Infrastructure.
* 9+ years' experience with Network, Cloud, and Data Center services including experience in a managed infrastructure services environments.
* 5 years' experience in operational governance, project management, financial management, and/or vendor/supplier management.
* 2+ years of experience with end-to-end delivery of operations or project delivery accountability.
* Demonstrated experienced in improving the efficiency and effectiveness of IT delivery and operations.
* Experience leading complex (multi-million) projects involving internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experiences, and achievements with three or more of the following technologies: Windows, UNIX/Linux, Mainframe, Storage, Cloud (Private and Public), LAN/WAN, Firewall, Voice, Messaging, Middleware, Database, Infrastructure Security.

**Additional Technical Expertise**

We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:

* **Hands-on cloud experience**
  with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Oracle Cloud.
* **Infrastructure design and engineering experience**
  , including implementing and supporting cloud-based solutions.
* **Cloud networking expertise**
  , including an understanding of network architecture, connectivity and configurations.
* **Relevant certifications**
  , particularly in Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud and/or ITIL.
* Strong technical problem-solving, stakeholder collaboration and vendor management capabilities.

Experience across all three cloud platforms is not required; practical expertise in one or more is valuable.

At WSIB, you'll have the opportunity to work with evolving technologies, contribute to meaningful infrastructure initiatives and collaborate with experienced IT professionals.

Title: Restoration Manager
Description:
**RESTORATION MANAGER**

  
  

**About telMAX Inc.:**

  

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  
  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

  

The Restoration Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all restoration activities associated with TelMAX’s Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) construction program. This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

  
  

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

  

Restoration Management

  

  
* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
  
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
  
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
  
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
  
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
  
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  

  
  

Vendor Management

  

  
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
  
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
  
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
  
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
  
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
  
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
  
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.
  

  
  

Field Coordination & Quality

  

  
* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
  
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
  
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
  
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
  
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
  
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.
  

  
  

Project Tracking & Reporting

  

  
* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
    
    
  + Outstanding restoration items
    
  + Vendor assignments
    
  + Target completion dates
    
  + Aging of outstanding items
    
  + Deficiencies and rework
    
  + Municipal inspection status
    
  + Completed/closed restoration
  
* Provide regular reporting to Construction leadership on restoration progress, risks, and vendor performance.
  
* Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure restoration performance across the FTTH program.
  
* Identify trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  

  
  

Municipal & Stakeholder Coordination

  

  
* Work closely with Municipal Relations and Construction teams to understand municipal restoration requirements and deadlines.
  
* Support responses to municipal restoration complaints, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* Coordinate vendor responses to municipal requirements and inspection findings.
  
* Help ensure restoration commitments made to municipalities are tracked and delivered.
  
* Support the resolution of property-owner restoration concerns where required.
  

  
  

Financial Management

  

  
* Monitor restoration costs and vendor spend against approved budgets.
  
* Identify potential cost overruns, unauthorized work, and additional restoration costs.
  
* Review vendor restoration claims and supporting documentation as required.
  
* Escalate material cost variances and financial risks to Construction leadership.
  
* Support the recovery of costs from vendors where restoration deficiencies or rework are attributable to vendor performance.
  

  
  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  

Accountable for improving and maintaining performance against key restoration metrics, including:

  

  
* Percentage of restoration completed within required timelines
  
* Aging of outstanding restoration items
  
* Number of overdue restoration items
  
* Municipal restoration deficiencies
  
* Restoration rework rate
  
* Vendor restoration performance
  
* Time from construction completion to final restoration
  
* Time from deficiency identification to correction
  
* Number of open municipal complaints related to restoration
  
* Restoration cost per home/premise
  
* Percentage of builds achieving municipal closeout/acceptance
  

  
  

**What You Bring:**

  

  
* **Accountability:**
   Takes ownership of restoration outcomes and drives issues to closure.
  
* **Vendor Management:**
   Holds vendors accountable while maintaining productive working relationships.
  
* **Execution:**
   Focuses on completing work and closing outstanding items rather than simply tracking them.

Title: Assistant Claims Manager
Description:

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

As Assistant Claims Manager, you will lead the delivery of high-quality claims advisory and advocacy services across sensitive and complex medical and life claims. You will support clients and members through critical moments, guide a team of Claims Advisors, and work closely with insurers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to achieve fair, timely and effective outcomes.

The role combines hands-on case leadership, complaint resolution, client and insurer engagement, regulatory awareness and people management. You will also contribute to service improvement, technology enablement and the continued development of our claims value proposition.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Lead complex claims and case management**

* Review and provide direction on sensitive, denied, disputed and complex claims, including pre-authorisation escalations, VIP claims and matters escalated by clients or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate medical evacuation and repatriation cases from initial escalation through resolution, maintaining clear communication with all parties.
* Lead case management for members with sensitive or high-cost conditions, including cancer, rare disorders and terminal illness; review utilisation, cost-containment needs and second medical opinion requirements.
* Provide practical resolution support to team members on denial disputes and complex coverage questions, advocating for outcomes that reflect client expectations and policy terms.
* Escalate emerging risks, disputes and complex cases promptly to the Head of Claims and senior management in line with agreed protocols.
  

  

**Resolve complaints and strengthen client confidence**

* Ensure complaints are fully investigated and responses clearly explain the cause, outcome and actions taken to prevent recurrence.
* Manage complaints that are not upheld by explaining findings, setting clear expectations and guiding members through the appropriate complaint route, including regulatory escalation where required.
* Maintain accurate complaint records in line with internal processes and applicable DHA requirements.
* Participate in client and insurer visits, including sensitive group renewal discussions where your claims expertise is required.
* Prepare quarterly service reports for key clients and provide clear updates on open cases, risks and actions.
  

  

**Build effective insurer and stakeholder relationships**

* Maintain trusted working relationships with insurers and third-party administrators, clearly communicating expectations and advocating for mutual clients.
* Engage with clients, colleagues, providers and insurers to progress complex cases and reach timely, well-supported decisions.
* Participate in periodic case review meetings and ensure actions are documented and closed within agreed timelines.
  

  

**Lead and develop the team**

* Implement team standards, claims procedures and best-practice controls across advisory and transactional claims activity.
* Allocate new accounts and workload, monitor capacity and oversee the smooth delivery of team operations across medical and life claims.
* Review claims files and deliverables to maintain quality, accuracy and service standards; monitor denied cases and cases approaching or exceeding turnaround time.
* Hold regular team and cross-functional meetings, summarise actions and follow through to closure.
* Mentor, coach and train direct reports on procedures, policies, claims practice and effective client interactions.
  

  

**Strengthen compliance, records and service improvement**

* Apply sound knowledge of DHA and DOH mandates, treatment guidelines, exclusions and regulatory updates, and translate relevant developments into practical team guidance.
* Protect confidential information by following data protection, encryption and clear-desk requirements; report and help prevent data incidents.
* Ensure claims, submissions, follow-ups, successes and appreciations are recorded accurately and in real time to support dashboards and management reporting.
* Support technology initiatives, proof-of-concept testing, change adoption, process improvement and appropriate use of AI to create capacity and enhance client service.
  

  

**Support embedded member services**

* Act as a trusted point of contact for members and client representatives under designated client programmes, including on-site support where agreed.
* Explain claims procedures, benefits, co-payments, provider access and approved support channels in clear, accessible language.
* Coordinate pre-authorisation, treatment requests, guarantee-of-payment requests, reimbursement queries, declined or suspended claims and reconsiderations through authorised channels.
* Track requests, missing information, ownership, ageing, escalation history and closure status, ensuring clear handovers and service updates.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in claims, healthcare benefits, insurance or a closely related environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in medicine or a related medical field.
* Experience leading and motivating diverse teams, including colleagues working remotely or across geographies.
* Strong knowledge of insurer claims processes, claims adjudication criteria, market developments and regulatory requirements.
* Proven claims advocacy, complaint resolution, crisis management, negotiation and client-management capability.
* Strong analytical, time-management, computer and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret data and dashboards and turn insight into action.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the judgement and empathy to support members and clients through sensitive situations.
* A practical, improvement-oriented approach to technology, process change and service quality.
  

  

**Working arrangements**

This is a hybrid role with a typical expectation of three days per week in the office. Client-site attendance, working hours and backup arrangements will be agreed separately where the role requires embedded member support. The role carries a low or normal level of physical and mental risk.

Title: Manager, Clinical Services
Description:
**Manager, Clinical Services – Intensive Services**

Full time-37.5 hours per week

***EveryMind Mental Health Services*** is currently recruiting for an experienced mental health professional with significant leadership experience in community healthcare for the position of **Manager, Clinical Services**.

***EveryMind*** is an accredited child and youth mental health organization that provides a continuum of high-quality mental health services for children, youth and their families who are experiencing or are at risk of experiencing mental health issues.

**Summary of Function**

Under the leadership of the Director, Clinical Services, the Manager is accountable for the effective delivery of services that are in keeping with the organization’s mission, vision, values, clinical and management philosophies, accreditation standards, policies, procedures and annual Service Plan. This position forms part of the Clinical Management Team responsible for supporting the clinical strategic direction, clinical decision-making and clinical policy development for EveryMind.

This portfolio is accountable to manage the organization’s Brief Services (Tangerine Single Session Counselling and One Stop Talk/Parlons maintenant), Counselling and Therapy Services, 24/7 Crisis Support and Respite Services. The Manager is responsible for ensuring trauma-informed/trauma-specific, evidence-based/evidence-informed practices are integrated across services, with a focus on supporting children, youth and families with complex mental health needs, including concurrent mental health and substance use disorders. The incumbent is responsible for direct supervision of up to 7 direct supervisor reports, for indirect management of up to 90 front line staff and accountability for an annual operating budget of approximately $7.5 million.

Annual Salary: Hiring range **$107,448 - $116,216 (step 1-3 in a 5 step pay band)**

Please note that hiring salaries are commensurate with experience and generally start at the beginning of the range.

***Why work at EveryMind?***

* Work for an organization that is the ***lead agency*** in child and youth mental health services for Region of Peel, known for our excellence in providing quality services.
* Contribute to the mental health & wellbeing of children and youth.
* A strong workplace wellness focus: ***4 weeks paid vacation***, **2 float days, 5 days Management compensatory time**, paid personal leave days, in addition to 11 paid public holidays.
* An Extended Health Plan that includes ***$1000 for mental health supports*** and a ***Flexible Health Spending Account.***
* An excellent extended health and dental benefits plan**,** ***all premiums fully paid by the employer, no co-pay required by the employee******.***
* Income protection Sick leave Plan and Life insurance.
* Free, confidential 24/7 counselling and mental health support for you and your family via our Employee and Family Assistance Program.
* An exceptional ***Retirement Plan*** where the employer contributes 7% equivalent of your salary to your personal pension plan.
* Enjoy exceptional training and development opportunities including an ***Education Assistance Plan*** to support employees in further education in their field.
* A workplace culture that embraces ***Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Anti-racism (DEIA)*** with employee-led internal committees focusing on Black Engagement, LGBTQ2S, Indigenous Knowledge.

**Responsibilities**

* **Operations**

* Provides administrative and/or clinical oversight and direction to the program areas of responsibility working collaboratively and cooperatively across the agency to create an integrated operational service.
* Oversees clinical accountability for Key Performance Indicators and reporting compliance to funders using data dashboards and other reporting tools.
* Leads operational efficiency within assigned portfolio through providing oversight to program Supervisors and direct service staff.
* Ensures compliance with relevant legislation, accreditation standards, policies and procedures and implements changes in the same, if any, all Occupational Health and Safety and Infection & Prevention Control (IPAC) requirements
* Participates in Clinical on Call coverage roster. Manages approved budgets, staffing and allocated resources in order to achieve the desirable deliverables, targets, goals and objectives.
* **Strategic Planning**

* In collaboration with the Director, provide input into the Organization’s clinical services strategic planning and educational learning plans decision-making and policy formulation processes.
* Ensure the delivery of high-quality clinical services through the integration of evidence informed/based practices and monitoring of program outcomes.
* Engages in continuous Quality Improvement activities to meet changing needs within both a virtual and in person operation framework in support of high-quality service provision.
* Contribute to the development of existing and new clinical services with a focus on growth for serving Marginalized and Racialized clients and their families
* **Training & Development**

* Identify, develop, implement professional training and development programs to enhance skill, knowledge and professional development of clinical teams across the organization.
* Support and encourage further organizational development through implementing and overseeing quality standards from Accreditation Canada and other best practices in partnership with the System Planning and Accountability Department.
* **Community and Funders**

* Maintain an awareness of community needs for services within portfolio and participates in community meetings, funder meetings and professional groups as required.
* Actively represent the organization, build and maintain positive working relationships with funding agencies, external organizations, service agencies and stakeholders clearly communicating the organizations goals and future directions.

**Knowledge, Education and Experience**

* Master’s Degree in Social Work, Psychotherapy, or other Health Professional Field with membership in the appropriate profession/regulated College.
* A minimum of seven years clinical experience, three of which must have been in a clinical leadership role, supervising a team of mental health professionals, preferably at the supervisory level.
* Strong knowledge of children and youth mental health sector and the related legislation.
* Demonstrated understanding of child and youth development, family systems, trauma, and concurrent disorders.
* Experience working with provincial government funders and funders’ accountabilities.
* Must have a strong understanding and knowledge of funder portals and reporting standards.
* Understanding and application of EMHware and the ChYMH suite of Clinical Assessment Tools, HEADS-ED and C-SSRS is an asset.
* Bilingualism in French and English is a definite asset.
* Proven collaborative leadership skills, with the ability to develop and articulate a clinical direction, gaining acceptance and buy-in of others in that direction.
* Demonstrated ability to work in partnership with others in terms of an integrated regional network of service delivery with other providers.
* Demonstrated ability to build cultural competence in clinical services and promote equitable and inclusive practices across the organization and its community partners
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Teams, Excel and Outlook, virtual platforms and experience with client information databases and reports.
* Ability to do After Hours On call duties in rotation with Clinical Management Team
* Valid Ontario Driver’s license (Class G) and use of a vehicle with a comfort in driving throughout the Peel region and surrounding areas.
* A Satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Police Check and Pre-Employment Medical screening (including TB test, COVID-19 Vaccination, MMR, TD, Polio Vaccination), is required.

Title: Senior Manager, Clinical & Operational Service
Description:
**Company Description**

Heart & Vascular Partners LLC ("HVP") is a leading national management services organization built to support independent cardiology and vascular practices. Founded by clinicians, for clinicians, HVP provides managed care contracting, facility development and operations, revenue cycle management, and marketing services through a national, scaled delivery platform.

HVP currently partners with practices across Oklahoma, Colorado, Illinois, Missouri, and Texas, and supports the management of ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs).

**Role Summary**

The Senior Manager, Clinical & Operational Services is a hands-on, execution-focused role that carries assigned initiatives from field assessment through implementation and completion across HVP's partner practices and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs). The role spends significant time in the field working directly with practice and ASC teams to solve problems, implement clinical and operational improvements, and ensure completed work is adopted and sustained.

Approximately 25% of the role is dedicated to ASC quality, credentialing, and clinical compliance. A central responsibility is connecting ASC operations with the affiliated practice so workflows, provider credentialing, quality activities, and compliance needs are coordinated.

**Scope of the Role**

* Executes priorities assigned by the Chief Operating Officer and HVP leadership; this is a working role, not a strategy-setting position.
* Works alongside practice and ASC leaders without owning P&L, budgets, operational outcomes, or direct supervision of administrators.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Hands-on Implementation and Assigned Initiatives**

* Take assigned initiatives from field assessment through implementation, including building practical work plans, completing tasks, coordinating contributors, resolving issues, and closing out the work.
* Work directly with practice and ASC teams on site to understand current conditions and perform the detailed work needed to move initiatives forward.
* Maintain clear timelines, task ownership, and status updates; identify risks early and escalate barriers to the COO.
* Provide hands-on launch, implementation, and follow-up support, confirming that changes are completed, understood, and sustained.

**ASC Quality, Credentialing, and Clinical Compliance**

* Oversee ASC quality initiatives, quality reporting, and follow-through on identified improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate and monitor ASC provider credentialing and recredentialing, working with credentialing teams, ASC leaders, physicians, and affiliated practices to keep files complete and current.
* Connect ASC operations with the affiliated practice so clinical workflows, provider schedules, credentialing, quality activities, and compliance requirements are aligned.
* Support accreditation, licensure, and regulatory survey readiness, including preparation, on-site support, and tracking corrective action plans through completion.
* Monitor clinical compliance needs and implement practical corrective actions, policies, training, and documentation.
* Coordinate ASC leader communications and support assigned inventory, supply, vendor, and compliance initiatives.

**Clinical Workflows and Operational Improvement**

* Assess current workflows on site and identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for standardization.
* Implement standardized clinical and operational workflows while allowing appropriate practice-level flexibility.
* Work with practice administrators, clinical managers, and physicians to improve clinic flow, scheduling, and care coordination.
* Document workflows and create playbooks, reference guides, and standard operating procedures.

**Training and Change Support**

* Develop and deliver training for new workflows, systems, and processes.
* Create training materials, competency tools, and reference guides.
* Support practices and ASCs through change by being present, responsive, and hands-on during transitions.

**Field Presence and Practice Support**

* Maintain a regular, visible presence at partner practices and ASCs to assess needs, support implementations, and confirm project completion.
* Bring field feedback back to HVP leadership so priorities reflect real practice needs.
* Serve as a dependable, go-to resource for practice and ASC teams.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Other duties as assigned, including limited support for technology implementations or provider transitions when needed.

**Essential Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to organize and carry multiple assigned initiatives through completion while performing detailed work directly with field teams.
* Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach with strong follow-through.
* Highly organized and detail oriented.
* Clear, practical communicator with clinic staff, administrators, physicians, and leadership.
* Ability to build trust and influence without direct authority.
* Working knowledge of clinical operations, preferably in cardiovascular or specialty care.
* Working knowledge of healthcare regulatory, credentialing, quality, and accreditation requirements, including HIPAA, OSHA, state ASC licensure, and CMS Conditions for Coverage.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Clinical Sciences, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in healthcare operations, clinical operations, or ASC operations.
* Demonstrated experience carrying implementations, quality initiatives, or process improvements from assessment through completion.
* Experience working directly with physicians and clinical teams.
* Ability to travel 30–50% and work on site at partner practices, ASCs, and the HVP office.

**Preferred**

* Clinical license (RN, NP, PA, RT, or other allied health professional).
* Experience in a multi-site healthcare organization, MSO, or ASC environment.
* Experience supporting ASC credentialing, accreditation, quality programs, or regulatory surveys.
* Quality improvement, healthcare compliance, or execution-focused training or certification, such as Lean or Six Sigma.

**Work Environment, Travel, and Physical Demands**

This role works in the HVP office, at partner practices and ASCs, and in clinical environments. In-office presence and regular, in-person field engagement are expected.

Travel to partner practice and ASC locations is required, estimated at 30–50% of the time, and will vary based on project timelines and practice needs. Attendance at company-wide meetings is expected at least once per quarter.

The employee is regularly required to see, talk, hear, stand, walk, and use hands. Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds may be required.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Heart and Vascular Partners provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

Description:

Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Programme IA Fabric de Bell**
est une initiative de transformation visant à déployer une infrastructure de centres de données évolutive et essentielle aux opérations. Le
**gestionnaire, contrôle de programme**
sera responsable d’établir et de maintenir les processus de gouvernance qui assurent la coordination entre les différents services, projets et parties prenantes du programme.
  
  
Relevant du ou de la
**directeur, contrôle de programme**
, cette personne fournira un leadership dans les domaines suivants : la gestion des interfaces et des transferts, la gouvernance des risques, l’analyse des causes fondamentales, la capitalisation des leçons apprises, l’amélioration continue, la gestion des mesures de suivi ainsi que la coordination du contrôle des changements.
  
  
Le titulaire du poste contribuera à maintenir une vision intégrée et fiable des risques, des dépendances, des actions et des initiatives d’amélioration du programme afin de soutenir une exécution prévisible et efficace des projets.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
**Gestion des interfaces et des transferts**

* Administrer le registre des transferts et interdépendances du programme.
* Coordonner les revues interfonctionnelles entre les équipes de développement, d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de construction, de mise en service, d’exploitation, de sécurité, des TI et les parties prenantes réglementaires.
* Surveiller les dépendances, les critères d’entrée et de sortie ainsi que les exigences de transfert à chaque phase du projet.
* Identifier et signaler les enjeux liés aux dépendances, aux livrables, aux responsabilités et aux étapes critiques.

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.
* Coordonner les revues de risques, le suivi des mesures d’atténuation et les actions correctives.
* Diriger ou faciliter les analyses des causes fondamentales pour les enjeux majeurs ayant un impact sur les coûts, les échéanciers ou la performance.
* Analyser les tendances et recommander des mesures préventives ou correctives.

**Leçons apprises et amélioration continue**

* Développer et maintenir un cadre structuré de leçons apprises.
* Recueillir et intégrer les apprentissages aux principaux jalons du programme.
* Traduire les leçons retenues en améliorations des procédures, normes, outils et pratiques de livraison.
* Animer des ateliers et revues visant l’amélioration continue et l’efficacité des contrôles.

**Gestion des actions et gouvernance**

* Mettre en place un processus de suivi des actions à boucle fermée.
* Veiller à ce que les actions, risques, décisions et initiatives d’amélioration soient assignés, suivis et clôturés adéquatement.
* Assurer des suivis réguliers et fournir à la direction une visibilité sur les enjeux, retards et décisions requises.

**Gestion du changement**

* Coordonner le processus de contrôle des changements et les évaluations d’impact.
* Assurer l’alignement des changements avec les risques, les dépendances, les transferts et les références du programme.
* Maintenir des registres, journaux de décisions et rapports de gouvernance vérifiables.

**Rapports et soutien au contrôle de programme**

* Produire des tableaux de bord et rapports exécutifs sur les risques, les interfaces, les actions, les changements et les initiatives d’amélioration.
* Soutenir les cycles de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes du programme.
* Fournir des analyses sur les tendances, les dépendances et les risques émergents.
* Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils, normes et pratiques de contrôle de programme.
* Agir comme point central d’intégration de l’information tout en assurant l’imputabilité des équipes responsables de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience progressive en contrôle de programme, contrôle de projet, gestion de bureau de projets (PMO), gestion des risques, gouvernance de programme, amélioration continue ou réalisation de grands projets d’investissement (CAPEX).
* Expérience démontrée dans la coordination de programmes ou de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires impliquant plusieurs équipes internes, consultants, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs.
* Solide compréhension des pratiques de gestion des risques, des enjeux, des mesures correctives, des changements, des interfaces et de la gouvernance.
* Expérience dans l’animation d’analyses des causes profondes (Root Cause Analysis) et dans la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution.
* Capacité à intégrer les données liées aux échéanciers, aux coûts, aux risques, aux changements et au transfert des livrables afin d’offrir une vision globale et intégrée du programme.
* Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles, d’animation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes et à produire des rapports concis destinés à la haute direction.
* Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365 et bonne connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de projets et de production de rapports.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience dans le soutien à la réalisation de projets de centres de données, d’infrastructures critiques (mission-critical), de télécommunications ou d’infrastructures hyperscale.
* Connaissance du cycle de vie des centres de données, incluant la planification, la conception, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service (commissioning), la préparation opérationnelle et le transfert aux équipes d’exploitation.
* Connaissance des environnements critiques liés aux systèmes électriques, mécaniques, de refroidissement, d’automatisation et contrôle, de réseaux et de sécurité.
* Expérience avec les outils Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint ou d’autres plateformes similaires de contrôle de projets.
* Certification professionnelle PMP (Project Management Professional), PMI-RMP (PMI Risk Management Professional), PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), CCP (Certified Cost Professional), Lean Six Sigma ou certification équivalente

**Exigences supplémentaires**

* Leadership transversal et capacité à influencer et mobiliser les parties prenantes sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Excellentes aptitudes en résolution structurée de problèmes et solide jugement professionnel.
* Sens des responsabilités, rigueur dans le suivi des dossiers et grande attention aux détails.
* Capacité à remettre en question de façon constructive, à formuler des recommandations pertinentes et à escalader les enjeux avec clarté lorsque nécessaire.
* Excellentes habiletés de communication avec la haute direction et capacité à présenter des analyses et recommandations fondées sur les données.
* Mentalité d’amélioration continue et engagement envers l’apprentissage organisationnel et le partage des meilleures pratiques.

Title: Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director
Description:
**Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery**

**(This role can be based in any global Worley office)**

**About Worley**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets.

With more than 40,000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The role**

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio.

**Why this role matters**

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers.

* Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability.

Title: Tech Lead - Conversational AI & Driver Automation
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
We are looking for an Engineering Lead to own and drive Snoonu's Conversational AI and Driver Automation platform — a portfolio spanning IVR systems, multi-channel chatbots, and a production-grade multi-agent Agentic AI framework built on AWS Bedrock. **🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
