Title: IT Support Supervisor
Description:
**Summary of Primary Functions****:**

The IT Support Supervisor leads the IT Support team at Dobbs Equipment, with the IT Specialists reporting directly to this position. Building on the core IT Support Specialist role, the Supervisor manages the team's people, priorities and performance, owns the health of the service desk, resolves the most complex escalations and keeps service levels on track for a growing, multi-site workforce of roughly 870 employees.

A defining part of this role is continuity of leadership. When the Vice President, IT Systems & Strategic Projects is out of office, the IT Support Supervisor steps in as the acting point of contact for the IT department: directing daily priorities, coordinating the team, managing incidents, communicating with business leaders and making operational decisions within a defined delegation of authority. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on skill with sound judgment, calm under pressure and the leadership ability to manage, develop and hold a team accountable. *This job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties. Dobbs Equipment may modify responsibilities to meet business needs.*

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities****:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.*(Other duties may be assigned)*

### **People Leadership and Acting Department Coverage:**

* Serve as the designated backup to the Vice President, IT Systems & Strategic Projects, acting as the primary IT contact for executives, managers and vendors during planned and unplanned absences.
* Lead the daily IT Support stand-up, assign and rebalance tickets, and manage team schedules, PTO approvals, timekeeping and the on-call rotation.
* Directly supervise the IT Specialists: set clear goals, hold regular one-on-ones, complete performance reviews, recognize strong work and address performance or conduct issues in partnership with HR.
* Lead hiring for IT Support positions, including interviews and hiring recommendations to the VP; onboard, train and mentor new team members and build learning paths so the team resolves issues faster.
* Brief the VP on decisions made, open issues and escalations upon return, and maintain a running coverage log.

### **Service Desk Ownership and Operations:**

* Own the service desk queue end to end: ticket intake, triage standards, categorization, SLA targets and backlog reduction.
* Monitor team metrics (tickets opened versus closed, backlog older than seven days, first-contact resolution, time to resolve, customer satisfaction) and report trends to the VP monthly.
* Identify recurring issues and drive root-cause fixes, automation and self-service options that reduce ticket volume.
* Maintain the IT knowledge base, standard operating procedures and runbooks so any specialist can resolve common requests consistently.

### **Advanced Technical Support and Escalation:**

* Act as the final internal escalation point (Tier 2/3) for desktop, laptop, mobile, printing, network, VoIP and application issues before vendor escalation.
* Administer Microsoft 365 and identity services, including Entra ID / Active Directory, Exchange Online, Intune device management, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, security groups and access requests.
* Support business systems used across the dealership, coordinating with the Dynamics, Power Platform and Power BI developers on access, data and application issues.
* Oversee device lifecycle management: imaging, hardware refreshes, asset inventory, warranty and secure disposal.
* Review and respond to system and security alerts, escalating appropriately and documenting actions taken.

### **Incident, Change and Security Management:**

* Lead the response to major incidents and outages, coordinate technicians and vendors, and provide clear, timely status updates to leadership and affected users.
* Follow and enforce change management practices for system updates, patching and configuration changes, approving routine changes within delegated authority.
* Uphold security standards including least-privilege access, MFA, endpoint protection, patch compliance and user access reviews; participate in security awareness efforts.
* Support backup, recovery and business continuity testing for critical systems.

### **Vendor, Project and Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Serve as the day-to-day contact for IT vendors and managed service providers, including network, VoIP, hardware and software partners; track vendor tickets to resolution.
* Lead or support IT infrastructure projects such as hardware refreshes, branch openings and relocations, office moves and system rollouts, managing tasks, timelines and communication.
* Build relationships with branch and department leaders to understand their technology needs and set clear expectations on service and timelines.
* Assist with IT budgeting inputs, quotes, purchasing and license management.

**Delegation of Authority When Acting for the VP**
--------------------------------------------------

**Area**

**IT Support Supervisor may decide**

**Escalate to VP, CFO or executive leadership**

Team priorities and assignments

Reassign tickets, set daily priorities, approve shift, PTO and coverage changes

New positions, compensation changes, terminations

Incidents and outages

Declare and manage incidents, engage vendors, communicate status to users

Prolonged outages affecting multiple sites or revenue-critical systems, any suspected security breach

Access and security

Approve standard access requests per policy, disable accounts on termination or risk

Elevated or privileged access exceptions, policy exceptions

Changes and maintenance

Approve routine, pre-defined changes and maintenance windows

Major or non-standard changes to core business systems

Purchasing

Approve purchases within a pre-set spending limit

Purchases above the limit, new contracts or renewals

Communication

Respond to executives, managers and vendors on operational matters

Strategic, budget or personnel decisions

**Qualifications:** The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

* 5+ years of progressive IT support experience, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* Prior experience serving as acting manager or backup lead for an IT team.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID / Active Directory and Intune.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, switching) and VoIP systems.
* Experience managing a ticketing system, setting priorities and tracking service metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to supervise a team, including scheduling, coaching, performance reviews and difficult conversations.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical leaders.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to branch locations as needed.

**Education, Skill, and/or Experience Requirements****:**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience in a multi-site dealership, equipment, construction or field-service environment.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform or Power BI from a support and access perspective.
* Experience with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Power Automate) to reduce manual work.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+ or Security+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator or Endpoint Administrator, or ITIL Foundation.
* Prior experience serving as acting manager or backup lead for an IT team.

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

People leadership and coaching, sound judgment under pressure, ownership and accountability, customer service orientation, problem solving and root-cause analysis, prioritization across competing demands, documentation discipline, and integrity with confidential information.

**Success Measures:**
---------------------

Success in this role is measured by a declining support backlog and stable service levels, meeting ticket closure and response targets, the quality and timeliness of communication during incidents, the engagement, retention and growth of the team the Supervisor manages, and seamless department continuity whenever the VP is out of office.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee is regularly required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

**Work Environment:**

Primarily an office environment with regular travel to branch locations. Must be able to lift and move IT equipment up to 50 pounds. Participation in an on-call rotation and occasional after-hours or weekend work is required for incidents, maintenance windows and projects.

The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering Management or a related discipline is highly desirable.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, IEC 62443 or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, systems assurance, critical infrastructure, rail, transportation or major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Demonstrable experience delivering cybersecurity programmes on large-scale complex transportation, rail, metro, aviation, defence, utility or other critical infrastructure projects.
* Experience interfacing with government authorities, regulators, and owner organisations.
* Experience managing cybersecurity requirements through design, implementation, testing, and commissioning phases.
* Experience working within multi-contractor and international project environments.
* Previous Middle East or Saudi Arabia project experience is highly desirable.

**Knowledge Requirements**

* Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) frameworks, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Cybersecurity risk management and assurance methodologies.
* Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity.
* Railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, AFC, PSDs and station systems.
* IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related standards.
* Cybersecurity governance, auditing and compliance management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Risk-based decision making.
* Regulatory engagement and compliance management.
* Technical understanding of critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
* Contract and supplier management.
* Report writing and executive-level communication.

**Security Clearance**

The successful candidate must be capable of obtaining and maintaining any project, client or governmental security clearances required for the execution of the role.

Title: eMBMS Engineer
Description:
**Grow with us**
----------------

**About this opportunity:**

The Back Office (BO) eMBMS Engineer supports the availability, performance, and service continuity of the LTE Broadcast / evolved Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service platform used for mission-critical communications. The engineer owns second-line operational investigation and restoration of the Ericsson Mission Critical Broadcast Delivery Center (MC BDC) / Broadcast Core, and works across MCX application servers, LTE RAN, IP transport, cloud infrastructure, and network management teams to resolve end-to-end service issues.

This is an operations and service-assurance position, not sole ownership of RAN radio design, transport routing, MCX application logic, or cloud infrastructure. The engineer should understand those domains well enough to isolate faults, coordinate restoration, and validate outcomes.

**Join our Team**
-----------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Assurance and Incident Management**

* Degree or equivalent practical experience in telecommunications, networking, computer engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience supporting LTE/EPC or mission-critical communications platforms in a telecom operations / back-office environment, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of eMBMS/LTE Broadcast: MBMS sessions and bearers, MBSFN and service areas, SAI, TMGI, eNB/MCE, multicast versus unicast delivery, and synchronized radio transmission.
* Ability to trace control and user planes across MC AS, MC BDC, RAN, and transport; familiarity with Diameter, SCTP/M3AP, GTP-U/UDP, IP multicast, TCP/IP, routing, and time synchronization.
* Strong Linux troubleshooting skills, including logs, process/service checks, network diagnostics, and HA clustering; ability to use vendor OAM/CLI and performance counters safely.
* Clear technical communication, disciplined fault isolation, concise incident documentation, and willingness to participate in an on-call or shift rota if required by the service contract.

**Broadcast Core Operations**

* Operate and troubleshoot MDF-CP (provisioning and session control), MDF-UP (content ingestion, encoding/delivery and user plane), MDF-MH (M3 session handling), and MDF-DB (session persistence and recovery).
* Check Pacemaker/Corosync cluster health, resource placement, virtual IPs, database replication, node failover, and active/standby behavior; investigate HA and geographic failover with the MCX and infrastructure teams.
* Investigate stale or failed sessions and resource occupancy after path or site failures. Perform session restart, stop, cleanup, or failover actions only under an approved runbook/change or incident authority, with impact assessment and post-action validation.
* Maintain operational visibility of service-area configuration, SAI-to-cell/MBSFN mappings, MCX bearer parameters, interface connectivity, certificates, DNS/NTP, authorized network access, and capacity headroom; raise discrepancies to the configuration owner.
* Review component event, access, session, traffic, monitor, performance, and cluster logs; collect diagnostic bundles and preserve evidence for engineering/vendor escalation while following data-handling requirements.

**Change, Resilience and Improvement**

* Execute or support approved maintenance, upgrades, patches, backups/restores, parameter changes, certificate/license renewals, and redundancy tests, with pre-checks, rollback plans, and post-checks.
* Coordinate with RAN/ENM and the Broadcast Configuration and Area Manager (BCAM) owners on MBSFN-area and SAI configuration changes; validate their operational impact without assuming unilateral ownership of radio planning or provisioning.
* Partner with IP transport on multicast reachability and routing (for example, PIM-SSM and IGMPv3/MLDv2), with RAN on M1/M3 terminations and time/phase synchronization, and with cloud/platform teams on VM, storage, network, and OpenStack/CEE issues.
* Produce health-check procedures, troubleshooting playbooks, alarm-to-action mappings, handover notes, and capacity/availability reports; identify recurring faults and automate safe, read-only diagnostics where appropriate.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Degree or equivalent practical experience in telecommunications, networking, computer engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience supporting LTE/EPC or mission-critical communications platforms in a telecom operations / back-office environment, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of eMBMS/LTE Broadcast: MBMS sessions and bearers, MBSFN and service areas, SAI, TMGI, eNB/MCE, multicast versus unicast delivery, and synchronized radio transmission.
* Ability to trace control and user planes across MC AS, MC BDC, RAN, and transport; familiarity with Diameter, SCTP/M3AP, GTP-U/UDP, IP multicast, TCP/IP, routing, and time synchronization.
* Strong Linux troubleshooting skills, including logs, process/service checks, network diagnostics, and HA clustering; ability to use vendor OAM/CLI and performance counters safely.
* Clear technical communication, disciplined fault isolation, concise incident documentation, and willingness to participate in an on-call or shift rota if required by the service contract.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree or equivalent practical experience in telecommunications, networking, computer engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience supporting LTE/EPC or mission-critical communications platforms in a telecom operations / back-office environment, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of eMBMS/LTE Broadcast: MBMS sessions and bearers, MBSFN and service areas, SAI, TMGI, eNB/MCE, multicast versus unicast delivery, and synchronized radio transmission.
* Ability to trace control and user planes across MC AS, MC BDC, RAN, and transport; familiarity with Diameter, SCTP/M3AP, GTP-U/UDP, IP multicast, TCP/IP, routing, and time synchronization.
* Strong Linux troubleshooting skills, including logs, process/service checks, network diagnostics, and HA clustering; ability to use vendor OAM/CLI and performance counters safely.
* Clear technical communication, disciplined fault isolation, concise incident documentation, and willingness to participate in an on-call or shift rota if required by the service contract.

**Measures of Success**

* Broadcast incidents are detected, isolated, escalated, and restored within agreed service targets, with verified service recovery.
* Reduced recurring bearer/session failures and improved first-time accuracy of domain fault isolation and escalation evidence.
* Health checks, resilience tests, changes, and knowledge documentation are completed consistently and without avoidable service impact.

Title: Office Coordinator - MENA
Description:
### **Description**

The MENA Office Coordinator provides practical, hands-on administrative and operational support to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of Flint Culture's Dubai office and wider MENA operations.

Reporting to the Global Operations Manager and working closely with the HR Director and Finance team, the role supports office coordination, employee administration, compliance tracking, travel arrangements and general operational activities.

We're looking for someone who is naturally proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused - someone who thinks ahead, spots potential issues early and takes the initiative to find practical solutions. This is a varied role for someone who enjoys making things happen, takes pride in being organised and can work independently, using good judgement and knowing when to seek guidance.

Ideally, candidates will already hold valid UAE residency sponsorship and have their own medical insurance cover.

  

### **Main Duties & Responsibilities**

  

**Founder Support**

* Provide occasional administrative and practical support to the Founder as required, including coordinating documents, signatures and other routine requests.
* Assist with the day-to-day coordination of the Founder's driver, including scheduling, holiday booking, communication and practical arrangements.

**Office & Team Support**

* Coordinate the day-to-day running of the Dubai office, including supplies, facilities, maintenance and general office requirements.
* Help create a welcoming, professional and positive environment for employees and visitors.
* Liaise with office suppliers, building management and service providers as needed.
* Help organise team activities, celebrations and office events within agreed budgets.
* Act as a first point of contact for general office and administrative queries.

**General Administration & Operational Support**

* Assist with travel arrangements, bookings and other administrative requirements for the MENA team.
* Maintain organised electronic files, records, templates and trackers.
* Support the preparation and submission of routine business documentation, including registrations, supplier forms and tender administration.
* Help coordinate day-to-day operational tasks and follow up on outstanding actions.
* Provide general administrative support to the Global Operations Manager and wider team as required.

**Compliance & Renewal Administration**

* Maintain and update the Business Compliance & Renewals calendar, including company licences, registrations, visas and insurance renewals.
* Track important dates, organise supporting documentation and flag upcoming deadlines.
* Liaise with PROs, government service providers and internal colleagues to coordinate visa applications for new joiners, renewals, registrations and other required submissions, ensuring documentation is complete and deadlines are met.
* Ensure records and documentation are accurately maintained and filed.

**HR Administration**

* Support employee on-boarding and off-boarding, including local documentation, visas, insurance and practical arrangements.
* Use Shapes, our HR system, to coordinate and track onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring tasks are completed and records kept up to date.
* Coordinate regional medical insurance renewals, working closely with our brokers, HR and Finance teams to gather information, track renewal timelines, support policy administration and ensure continuity of cover.
* Act as a key point of contact for medical insurance brokers across the MENA region, supporting employee additions, removals, policy changes via the portal and day-to-day insurance queries.
* Liaise with HR, PRO providers and other partners to coordinate regional people administration.
* Maintain accurate and appropriately filed employee documentation and records.

**IT & Equipment Coordination**

* Coordinate IT setup and offboarding for new joiners and leavers, including laptops, equipment, system access and account deactivation.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of company equipment, including allocations, returns and replacements.
* Liaise with external IT support to coordinate equipment setup, resolve basic technical issues and ensure timely removal of access for leavers.
* Manage day-to-day IT support requests from the team, monitor outstanding tickets, follow up with IT support and escalating unresolved, urgent or recurring problems to the Global Operations Manager.

**Financial & Supplier Administration**

* Assist with processing and tracking supplier invoices, office expenses and payment requests.
* Maintain records of office expenditure, subscriptions and supplier costs.
* Obtain quotations and help coordinate supplier renewals and purchases.
* Ensure invoices, receipts and supporting documentation are provided to Finance.
* Flag discrepancies, unexpected charges or outstanding payments to the relevant team.

**Approach & Expectations**  
  
We're looking for someone who:

* *Is a natural problem solver* - approaches challenges with curiosity, common sense and a can-do attitude.
* *Thinks ahead and takes initiative* - anticipates what needs doing rather than waiting to be asked.
* *Is resourceful and solutions-focused* - looks for practical ways to resolve issues and brings suggestions when flagging problems.
* *Takes ownership* - follows tasks through to completion and doesn't let things fall between the cracks.
* *Is highly organised and detail-oriented* - stays on top of deadlines, records and competing priorities.
* *Is numerically confident and financially aware* - comfortable working with figures, understands the importance of budgets and costs, and has a good head for numbers.
* *Is confident working independently* - uses good judgement, knows when to make things happen and when to escalate.
* *Is approachable and collaborative* - enjoys helping others and building positive working relationships.
* *Is adaptable and willing to learn* - comfortable with technology, new systems and changing priorities.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

  

* Previous experience in office coordination, administration, team support or a similar role.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to handle confidential information securely.
* Confidence using Google Workspace or similar office applications.
* Ability to manage routine administrative tasks and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable liaising with colleagues, suppliers and external service providers.
* Experience working in the UAE is desirable.
* Familiarity with UAE visa, PRO or business administration processes would be an advantage but is not essential.
* Fluent English; Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential.
* Willing and able to travel to our Abu Dhabi office as required to provide operational and administrative support.

  

### **Why join us?**

  

* People first approach - we want to develop a deep sense of belonging & inclusion for all our people.
* Culture for Good - our strengths based culture is an important touchpoint in our overall employee experience.
* Our footprint is growing - we deliver campaigns worldwide through offices in the UK and Middle East, supported by an international network of consultants.
* Multidisciplinary teams - providing integrated communications services across strategy, media relations, marketing, content creation and social media.
* Breadth of experience - varied work across the cultural and creative industries, spanning different disciplines and targeting both consumer and industry audiences.

### **About Flint Culture**

We are an international culture-led communications and strategy consultancy firm. As believers in the transformative power of culture, we work at the intersection of arts and cultural intelligence to drive meaningful change, amplify impact and foster connections. Through our in-market teams across the UK, Europe, the Middle East and South Asia.

Title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
Description:
**Position Title:** Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

**Functional Group**: Executive

**Department:** Finance

**Salary Range:** $160,000 - $175,000

**FLSA status:** Full-time, Exempt

**Work conditions:** Office environment in historic building, not ADA accessible. Light lifting. Regular 40-hour work week, Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM. Periodic attendance of meetings and events outside of normal work hours should be expected.

**Reports to:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Fort Monroe Authority (FMA)

The CFO will be responsible for directing the financial activities of the FMA as a member of the senior management team and lead the communication of the financial objectives and performance results to the FMA Board of Trustees and Finance Committee, the Commonwealth of Virginia, the City of Hampton, stakeholders, and industry groups.

This senior executive position is responsible for the effective financial management of the FMA to design, implement, and communicate the fiscal management plan and direct the economic sustainability for the former Army installation at Fort Monroe in Hampton, Virginia, to preserve the historic assets and character of Fort Monroe. Coordination, communication, motivation, and strategic planning are imperative to create collaboration between the departments to inspire staff, incorporate partnerships, seek stakeholder support, and effectively procure and utilize available financial resources to execute the strategic plan and ensure compliance with the Fort Monroe Programmatic Agreement, Design Standards, and other governing documents for the reuse of Fort Monroe.

The CFO shall work with the Department Directors to develop annual budgets and capital improvement plans and produce monthly financial statements to report on the progress of year-to-date results compared to the financial plans.

The CFO will have direct management responsibility of the Finance department, which includes Accounting, Procurement, Human Resources, and Grant Management, and outside contractors as necessary.

**Organizational responsibilities of the CFO:**

1. Serve on the Executive Team with the Chief Operating Officer (COO) to advise the CEO on strategic financial guidance and directives for the FMA.

2. Direct the creation and communication of short- and long-range financial goals and objectives for a unified plan for reuse and redevelopment of Fort Monroe. Lead the fiscal management of these objectives to implement the strategic plan for Fort Monroe.

3. Create a collaborative environment between Department Directors that establishes a unified vision for financial management for historic preservation of the Fort Monroe National Landmark designation.

4. Lead Department Directors in strategic financial discussions to identify operating and capital project funding necessary to address the reuse of historic and appropriate non-historic structures. Lead procurement of capital project funding to implement the Utility Master Plan to upgrade the utility services at Fort Monroe prior to transfer to the regional and municipal utility operators, and address the need for adequate roadways, sidewalks, parking, and other infrastructure resources to support the real estate and visitor services functions of Fort Monroe.

5. Provide financial coordination between the departments to ensure that programs are being implemented in alignment with the strategic financial plan for Fort Monroe.

6. Lead the annual process for budget and capital funding through the Commonwealth’s annual budget process. Lead the FMA’s annual operating budgets and capital improvement plans.

7. Lead the grant sourcing and administration plans in coordination with the Fort Monroe Foundation, National Park Service, and City of Hampton.

8. Provide management and analytical financial information to the CEO that demonstrates the FMA’s status and progress for reuse, historic preservation, and administrative operations.

9. Ensure coordination with the National Park Service and/or the City of Hampton on financial activities which affect the Fort Monroe National Monument or the City of Hampton

10. Serve as the acting CEO when delegated in writing by the CEO or FMA Board of Trustees.

**Departmental responsibilities of the CFO:**

1. Responsible for the development and approval of the FMA’s annual fiscal year budgets for Government Fund and four Enterprise Funds.

· Provide Department Directors with trailing twelve-month revenue and expense data. Solicit adjustments and new spending requests from Directors. Compile Department budgets. Review draft budgets with CEO. Make recommendations to balance budget.

· Prepare budget worksheets and supporting documentation. Present proposed budget to FMA Finance Committee and FMA Board of Trustees annually at their June meetings.

· Once budget is approved by Board of Trustees, prepare transmittal letters for review by CEO. Submit approved budget and transmittal letters to Chairs and staff of the Senate Finance and Appropriations Committee (SFAC) and House Appropriations Committee (HAC), the Director and staff of the Department of Planning and Budget (DPB), and Department of Legislative Services (DLS) on or before the July 1st start of each fiscal year.

2. Responsible for expense and revenue management performance to budget.

· Review monthly financial statements for variances against budget.

· Research cause(s) of variance and ensure reductions in other expenses or increases in revenue are identified to offset variances.

3. Responsible for development and submittal of annual budget decision documents and capital project funding as part of Commonwealth annual and biennial budget process.

· Identify requirements for additional general fund appropriations and/or capital project funding to meet CIP six-year plan requirements.

· Review funding needs with CEO.

· Prepare and submit decision packages into state budget system for DPB consideration. Prepare backup documentation for submittal with decision package.

· Prepare and submit capital outlay requests into state budget system for DPB consideration. Prepare backup documentation for submittal with decision package.

· Respond to any inquiries from DPB on additional capital funding request(s).

· Prepare briefing white papers or PowerPoint presentations and participate in meetings as necessary with DPB, SFAC staff, HAC staff, Secretary of Commerce and Trade, Secretary of Finance, and Governor as necessary.

4. Serve as responsible financial executive for annual external audit process.

· Work cooperatively with Accounting Manager and Accounting team to prepare for and respond to requests for information as part of the annual audit.

· Prepare Management Discussion and Analysis section of annual audit report.

· Review audit findings, if any, and work with Accounting Manager to develop management response to findings for audit report.

5. Serve as responsible financial executive for banking activities.

· Execute banking agreements necessary to efficiently and effectively manage banking relationships to comply with Commonwealth requirements for public funds.

6. Direct annual update to Capital Improvement Plan (CIP).

· Work with Department Directors, civil engineering consultant, and public works contractor to annually update six-year CIP worksheet for building, infrastructure, and utility capital projects.

· Prepare schedules and support narratives for detailed presentation to FMA Finance Committee and summary presentation to FMA Board of Trustees at their November meetings.

· Once approved, submit CIP to DPB analyst to meet requirement for six-year capital spending plan.

7. Serve as Fiscal Project Executive on all major infrastructure capital improvement projects.

· Work with consultants to develop project estimates.

· Prepare Capital Outlay forms and submit to DPB for allocation of capital project funding allocated to Fort Monroe in state budgets.

· Annually audit and reconcile capital project spending against previous allocations of capital funding from prior budgets.

8. Cooperatively manage Salary Administration Plan with Human Resources Director.

· Provide advice and counsel to Human Resources Director as necessary.

9. Assist Procurement Manager with procurement actions as necessary.

· Review Request for Proposal (RFP) or Request for Qualification (RFQ) documents as requested by Procurement Manager.

· Serve on evaluation RFP and RFQ panels as requested.

10. Assist Grants Manager with sourcing and administering public, private, and governmental grant funding.

· Review Notice of Funding Opportunity documents as requested by Grants Manager.

· Assist Grants Manager with periodic financial and administrative reports required by grant agreements.

11. Serve as FMA liaison for all legal services provided by the Office of the Attorney General.

· Submit requests to OAG for legal support services.

· Meet with OAG representatives as necessary.

· Review documents prepared by OAG.

12. Serve as contract executive for FMA managed technology contractor. Work with contractor on technology infrastructure management and life cycle replacement strategies and funding.

13. Serve as contract manager for Cooperative Management Agreement (CMA) with National Park Service (NPS).

· Prepare proposed annual budget worksheet for submittal to Fort Monroe National Monument Superintendent by deadline in current CMA.

· Work with NPS Superintendent to update budget worksheet.

· Ensure funding is allocated to reimburse FMA for cooperative contract services provided through CMA.

14. Foster and maintain strong working relationships with state partner organizations including Department of Planning and Budget, Department of General Services Office of Fiscal Services, Department of Treasury Division of Risk Management, and Department of Accounts.

15. Recruit, manage, evaluate, and develop direct reports including Accounting Manager, Human Resources Manager, Procurement Manager, and Grants Manager. Serve in Acting role for direct reports during any absences or vacancies.

16. Maintain regular communication with the CEO, COO, Department Directors, Finance department staff, stakeholders, and industry groups on financial activities of the FMA.

17. Make presentations to FMA Board of Trustees and Finance Committee, stakeholders, and industry groups on activities of the FMA.

18. Additional duties as assigned by the CEO.

**Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree in Finance, Accounting, Management, or related field with strong record of academic achievement. MBA or other related Master’s degree preferred. Significant business experience in related positions can substitute for educational requirements.

* Minimum of ten years experience in the field of financial management.

* Highly developed oral and written communication skills required.

* Demonstrated leadership skills and strategic management abilities to create a collaborative working environment among departments.

* Must be able to work on-site and be able to participate in scheduled on-site meetings.

* Ability to creatively solve problems, provide strategic leadership, and utilize the available resources of an organization to achieve maximum measurable results.

* Experience and specific understanding of the fiscal aspects of real estate redevelopment and management as well as the management of administrative functions related to real estate development.

* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with government officials, financial institutions, accounting industry professionals, community groups and organizations, and the public.

* Demonstrated knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and Government Accounting Standards Board (GASB) pronouncements required.

* Strong working knowledge of the Fair Labor Standards Act, Family Medical Leave Act, federal and state employments laws and regulations preferred.

* Working knowledge of the Virginia Public Procurement Act and Construction and Professional Service Manual preferred.

Eligible full-time state employees in the Commonwealth of Virginia receive a comprehensive package of health benefits, annual and holiday leave, retirement planning and savings options, insurance and work-life balance benefits managed through the Virginia Department of Human Resource Management (DHRM) and the Virginia Retirement System (VRS).

Note: All full-time employees are required to contribute 5% of annual salary toward their retirement account; in accordance with VRS retirement provisions. This will be handled through a pre-tax pay roll deduction

**Position Overview**

The Heart of House plays a vital role in supporting the day-to-day operations, ensuring that all behind-the-scenes functions are executed efficiently and to the highest standard. These positions are responsible for maintaining cleanliness, assisting in food preparation, managing inventory, or performing maintenance tasks that support the smooth running of guest-facing services. They are also responsible for plating entrees so they are appealing to the eye and represent the quality and integrity of the dish. Though not in direct contact with customers, Heart of House staff ensure that all operational systems run smoothly to enhance the overall guest experience which in turn creates guest loyalty by consistently and accurately preparing food.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

Essential duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

**Food Preparation:**

* Prepare, cook, and plate food to the standards set by the head chef or management. Follow the LDIR standard on all prepared products; label, date, initial, and rotate.
* Follow recipes and adjust based on guest requests (e.g., dietary restrictions).
* Assist in preparing ingredients (chopping, marinating, etc.) for dishes.
* Maintain and record proper temperature controls
* Carry out other duties assigned by the manager on duty and/or the kitchen manager.

**Quality Control:**

* Ensure all food leaving the kitchen meets the quality standards of the restaurant, including presentation and taste.

**Cleanliness and Sanitation:**

* Maintain a clean and organized workspace in compliance with food safety regulations.
* Follow proper hygiene procedures (washing hands, wearing gloves, sanitizing surfaces) during food preparation.

**Stock Management:**

* Assist with inventory management, keeping track of stock levels and notifying management when supplies are low.
* Assist with receiving and storing deliveries, checking for accuracy and quality.
* Properly store, rotate, and manage all food products following local, state, federal, and company guidelines and procedures.

**Equipment Maintenance:**

* Operate kitchen equipment (stoves, ovens, grills, etc.) safely.
* Report any faulty equipment to the kitchen manager or maintenance staff.

**Skills and Abilities Required**

* Ability to work in a fast paced team environment
* Knowledgeable of proper sanitation, food safety, and security procedures
* Ability to follow written and oral instructions in English.
* Knowledge of service standards and systems

* Ability to access online scheduling apps.

**Education and Experience Required**

* Prefer 3-5 years prior heart of house experience in a full service restaurant
* Serve Safe certification preferred

* Competitive pay
* Discounted meals
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Benefits and PTO (based on meeting hours requirements)
* Values - based leadership
* Opportunity for Advancement
* Flexible scheduling

Title: Safety Technician
Description:
Company Profile
  
With over 80 years of innovation, JCB is the world’s largest privately owned manufacturer of construction and agricultural equipment. Operating 23 manufacturing facilities across four continents—including the United States, the United Kingdom, India, and Brazil—JCB produces a diverse portfolio of more than 300 products. These include telescopic handlers, backhoe loaders, excavators, wheel loaders, compact excavators, skid steer loaders, compact track loaders, access aerial work platforms, rough terrain forklifts, and tractors.
  
At the heart of JCB’s success are its people. As a family-owned business, we are accountable to our customers—not shareholders—which gives us the flexibility to focus on long-term innovation and delivering real value. This independence allows us to continuously develop advanced technologies and integrate them into equipment designed to perform in the toughest environments while maximizing customer productivity.
  
At JCB, we stand behind our products—and our name—with pride and commitment to quality.
  
  
Position Purpose
  
The Safety Technician supports Environmental, Health and Safety programs and daily operations at JCB North America’s headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Pooler, Georgia. Working closely with the EHS Director, EHS Manager, EHS Specialist, operational leadership, and employees, this position helps promote a safe, compliant, and environmentally responsible workplace.
  
This role provides hands-on support for occupational safety, industrial hygiene, emergency preparedness, environmental compliance, incident prevention, and employee training. The Safety Technician maintains a visible presence throughout the facility, identifies and communicates potential hazards, assists with incident investigations, and helps ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
  
The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, approachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This position requires the ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization while maintaining consistent safety standards and reinforcing personal accountability.
  
Position Type
  
Full Time, Non-Exempt
  
Location
  
**Onsite:** 2000 Bamford Blvd Pooler, Georgia 31322
  
Benefits and Other Compensation
  
JCB offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401 (k) retirement plan; paid time off and paid holidays.
  
Application Process
  
Applications will be accepted through Careers | JCB Careers | JCB Jobs | JCB or via LinkedIn.
  
  
Major Tasks, Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities
  
Safety Program Support
  

* Provide day-to-day support for occupational safety and health programs applicable to a general industry manufacturing environment.
* Assist with the development, implementation, review, and continuous improvement of EHS policies, procedures, programs, and work instructions.
* Maintain a regular presence on the manufacturing floor to observe work practices, identify potential hazards, and provide timely guidance to employees and leaders.
* Support programs related to hazard communication, personal protective equipment, lockout/tagout, machine guarding, powered industrial trucks, walking-working surfaces, electrical safety, ergonomics, hearing conservation, respiratory protection, emergency response, and other applicable safety requirements.
* Assist departments in completing job hazard analyses, risk assessments, pre-task planning, and other proactive hazard-identification activities.
* Support the selection, use, inspection, and maintenance of required personal protective equipment.
* Promote employee engagement in safety programs, hazard reporting, near-miss reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor compliance with company safety requirements and communicate concerns to the appropriate employees, supervisors, and EHS leaders.
* Provide technical safety and health guidance to employees, supervisors, managers, contractors, and visitors.
* Support management in reinforcing safe work practices and addressing identified safety concerns.

Incident Management & Corrective Actions
  

* Respond promptly to workplace incidents, near misses, first-aid cases, injuries, illnesses, environmental events, and property-damage incidents.
* Support or lead incident investigations using a collaborative, team-based approach.
* Gather and document relevant information, including employee statements, photographs, equipment conditions, work procedures, training records, and other supporting evidence.
* Assist investigation teams in identifying immediate causes, contributing factors, and underlying root causes.
* Develop, document, assign, and track corrective and preventive actions through completion.
* Verify that corrective actions have been effectively implemented and are producing the intended results.
* Review incident and near-miss trends to identify recurring concerns and opportunities for prevention.
* Communicate investigation findings and lessons learned to the appropriate departments while maintaining required confidentiality.
* Support return-to-work, injury-management, and restricted-duty processes as assigned.

Regulatory Compliance & Recordkeeping
  

* Assist with maintaining accurate occupational safety records, logs, supporting documentation, and required reports.
* Support OSHA 300 recordkeeping activities, including the maintenance of incident documentation and case information.
* Assist the EHS team in preparing for regulatory inspections, internal reviews, customer audits, and third-party assessments.
* Maintain organized EHS files and records in accordance with company requirements and applicable retention periods.
* Track regulatory and program deadlines and communicate upcoming reporting, inspection, or renewal requirements.
* Help ensure required EHS postings, signage, labels, permits, and emergency information remain accurate, current, and visible.
* Support the collection and preparation of information used in regulatory submissions and leadership reports.
* Maintain the confidentiality of employee medical, incident, and other sensitive EHS information.

Environmental Compliance
  

* Support compliance activities associated with stormwater, wastewater, spill prevention, hazardous waste, universal waste, air emissions, chemical management, and other applicable environmental programs.
* Assist with environmental inspections, sampling coordination, documentation, and corrective-action tracking.
* Support the completion and maintenance of documentation associated with NPDES, SPCC, RCRA, and applicable federal, state, and local environmental requirements.
* Assist with required environmental reports and records, including Tier II, Toxic Release Inventory, discharge monitoring reports, hazardous-waste manifests, and other applicable documentation.
* Conduct or support routine inspections of waste-storage areas, chemical-storage locations, stormwater controls, spill-response equipment, and other environmental compliance areas.
* Assist with the proper identification, labeling, storage, handling, transportation, and documentation of hazardous and nonhazardous waste.
* Support spill-prevention and spill-response activities, including inspections of response materials and coordination of appropriate corrective actions.
* Help identify environmental risks and communicate concerns to EHS leadership and responsible departments.
* Partner with employees and operational teams to support waste reduction, recycling, resource conservation, and sustainability initiatives.

ISO 14001 & Management Systems
  

* Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the JCB North America environmental management system.
* Assist with activities supporting ISO 14001 implementation and ongoing conformance.
* Maintain environmental management system documentation, records, procedures, objectives, and action items.
* Support internal audits, management-review activities, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Help departments understand their responsibilities within the environmental management system.
* Assist with tracking environmental objectives, targets, performance indicators, and improvement plans.
* Support the preparation and organization of documentation for internal and external assessments.

Inspections, Audits & Hazard Identification
  

* Conduct routine safety and environmental inspections throughout manufacturing, warehouse, maintenance, office, laboratory, and exterior work areas.
* Document findings clearly and accurately, including identified hazards, responsible departments, recommended actions, and completion dates.
* Communicate urgent hazards immediately to the appropriate leader and EHS team member.
* Enter, assign, monitor, and close inspection and audit findings using established tracking systems.
* Verify completion and effectiveness of corrective actions through follow-up inspections.
* Participate in formal EHS audits and department-level safety reviews.
* Analyze inspection findings to identify patterns, recurring hazards, and improvement opportunities.
* Assist with contractor safety reviews and monitor contractor compliance while work is being performed on-site.
* Support inspections of emergency equipment, eyewash stations, safety showers, fire extinguishers, first-aid supplies, spill kits, and other safety-related equipment.
* Escalate conditions that present an immediate or significant risk in accordance with company procedures.

Training & Employee Engagement
  

* Assist with developing, coordinating, and delivering effective EHS training for employees, supervisors, contractors, and visitors.
* Conduct powered industrial truck and forklift training, evaluations, and certification activities in accordance with company requirements.
* Maintain accurate training attendance records, certifications, evaluation forms, and renewal dates.
* Support new-hire orientation by communicating key EHS expectations, emergency procedures, reporting requirements, and safe work practices.
* Deliver safety talks, toolbox topics, awareness campaigns, and refresher training based on operational needs and identified trends.
* Help ensure training materials are current, understandable, and appropriate for the intended audience.
* Coach employees on safe work practices and provide respectful, immediate feedback when unsafe conditions or behaviors are observed.
* Encourage employee participation in safety committees, hazard-reporting programs, and EHS improvement activities.
* Build positive relationships with employees and leaders to strengthen engagement and trust in the EHS function.

Emergency Preparedness
  

* Support emergency response planning, drills, training, and documentation.
* Assist with maintaining emergency action plans, evacuation maps, response procedures, and contact information.
* Participate in fire, severe-weather, spill-response, medical-response, and evacuation drills.
* Document drill results and track identified improvement actions.
* Inspect and help maintain emergency-response supplies and equipment.
* Assist with coordinating emergency response activities with Security, Facilities, Operations, and other internal teams.
* Support the investigation and documentation of emergency events and drills.

Data Analysis & Reporting
  

* Collect, organize, and review EHS data for accuracy and completeness.
* Assist with the preparation of weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual EHS performance reports.
* Track leading and lagging indicators, including incidents, near misses, observations, inspections, training completion, audit findings, and corrective actions.
* Help identify trends and prepare clear summaries for EHS and operational leadership.
* Maintain spreadsheets, databases, dashboards, action logs, and other EHS tracking tools.
* Communicate overdue or unresolved actions to the appropriate leaders.
* Support continuous improvement by using EHS data to identify recurring risks and recommend preventive actions.

General Responsibilities
  

* Maintain current knowledge of company EHS policies, manufacturing processes, equipment, and workplace hazards.
* Act as a positive and professional representative of the EHS department.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
* Participate in EHS meetings, safety committees, improvement projects, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Support special projects, regulatory activities, and operational needs as directed.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the EHS Director or EHS Manager.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* OSHA 10-Hour or OSHA 30-Hour General Industry training.
* Associate Safety Professional, Graduate Safety Practitioner, Occupational Health and Safety
* Technologist, Certified Environmental and Safety Compliance Officer, or similar certification.
* Powered industrial truck trainer or evaluator experience.
* First Aid, CPR, and AED certification.
* Hazardous-waste management or RCRA training.
* HAZWOPER or emergency spill-response training.
* Experience supporting environmental compliance programs within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience with ISO 14001 or environmental management systems.
* Experience assisting with internal audits, regulatory inspections, or incident investigations.
* Basic understanding of fire-protection systems, emergency-response equipment, and life-safety requirements.
* Familiarity with EHS management software, learning-management systems, or electronic corrective-action tracking tools.
* Must pass any drug screens, background checks, and any pre-employment tests, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable law.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Competencies
  

* Working knowledge of general industry safety principles and the ability to expand regulatory knowledge through ongoing training.
* Basic understanding of environmental compliance requirements associated with manufacturing operations.
* Ability to recognize workplace hazards and recommend practical corrective actions.
* Ability to conduct thorough inspections and document findings accurately.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining complete and organized records.
* Ability to investigate incidents objectively and gather accurate information.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and active-listening skills.
* Ability to communicate safety expectations clearly, respectfully, and consistently.
* Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, particularly when coaching employees or addressing unsafe conditions.
* Ability to build credibility and productive working relationships with employees at all levels.
* Ability to handle difficult conversations professionally and remain composed during urgent situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, inspections, training requirements, and corrective actions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team.
* Sound judgment and the ability to determine when an issue requires immediate escalation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and other business applications.
* Ability to learn and effectively use EHS databases, reporting platforms, and document-management systems.
* Demonstrated integrity and the ability to protect confidential and sensitive information.
* Commitment to workplace safety, environmental responsibility, employee engagement, and continuous improvement.

Job Conditions

* Subject to noise and temperature changes.

Physical Requirements
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those required of an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:
  

* Must be able to work flexible schedule, including Friday - Sunday 6am -6pm
* Must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 10lbs, frequently and/or move up to 35lbs, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50lbs.
* Must be able to perform continuous, repetitious physical activities. These activities may involve fine movements or large motions.
* Must be able to grasp/pinch small items, reach out and up, and turn wrist.

* Must be able to perform the following requirements of bending, stooping, climbing, kneeling, and standing for extended periods of time.

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role**

  

**Managerial**

* Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

  + Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

  

**Technical**

* Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include :

  + Working with patients to identify physical problems.

    - Developing and reviewing treatment programs.
    - Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.
    - Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.
    - Writing patient case notes and reports.
    - Collecting patient statistics.
    - Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.
  + Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

  + Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.
  + Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.
  + Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.
  + Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.
  + Maintaining a safe work environment.
  + Assisting in the on-going maintenance of a safe work place through involvement in the implementation of safe systems of work.
  + Identifying and reporting hazards in the workplace.
  + Participating in Quality Management System and commitment to processes of continuous improvement activities, including auditing, surveys and needs analysis.

  + Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infections

Title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
Description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

Job Description
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Technical Architect – Oracle Analytics, Middleware EBS
  
  
**Company:** NTT DATA
  
**Delivery Model:** Offshore
  
**Tower:** Application Infrastructure Services
  
**Capability:** Oracle Analytics Middleware
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**Experience Required:** 10+ Years
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking an experienced Technical Architect – Oracle Analytics, Middleware EBS to provide technical leadership and hands-on production support for enterprise Oracle Analytics environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a senior technical SME responsible for the architecture, administration, availability, performance, security, patching, modernization, and operational support of Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE/OBI), Oracle Fusion Middleware, WebLogic, Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Linux-hosted Oracle analytics platforms.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical architecture role requiring the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex production issues spanning the analytics, middleware, operating system, database, identity, security, and application layers.
  
  
The Technical Architect will also provide leadership for platform modernization, OBIEE-to-OAS migrations, major upgrades, patching, performance optimization, automation, disaster recovery, and environment lifecycle management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Oracle Analytics – OAS OBIEE
  
  
Provide architecture, administration, engineering, and production support for Oracle Analytics Server (OAS) and OBIEE/OBI environments.
  
  
Administer and troubleshoot Oracle Analytics services, configurations, repositories, catalogs, agents, scheduled jobs, caches, and usage tracking.
  
  
Monitor and troubleshoot report execution, dashboards, analytics services, and platform components.
  
  
Perform detailed log analysis and correlation across Oracle Analytics and associated middleware components.
  
  
Diagnose platform outages and execute appropriate service-restoration and recovery procedures.
  
  
Manage analytics repositories, catalogs, BAR files, RPDs, deployments, and environment-specific configurations.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex report, dashboard, semantic-model, repository, and data-access issues.
  
  
Monitor platform health, capacity, availability, and performance.
  
  
Provide technical guidance for analytics platform upgrades, modernization, migrations, and decommissioning.
  
  
Oracle Fusion Middleware WebLogic
  
  
Administer and support Oracle Fusion Middleware and Oracle WebLogic Server environments.
  
  
Manage WebLogic domains, Administration Servers, Managed Servers, Node Manager, clusters, and associated services.
  
  
Troubleshoot middleware startup, shutdown, communication, deployment, performance, and availability issues.
  
  
Manage RCU schemas, service accounts, credentials, and associated platform dependencies.
  
  
Configure and troubleshoot JDBC data sources, connection pools, database drivers, network ports, and aliases.
  
  
Support WebLogic domain configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle-management activities.
  
  
Analyze WebLogic and Fusion Middleware logs to identify and remediate complex production issues.
  
  
Oracle E-Business Suite Integration Support
  
  
Provide technical support for Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) dependencies associated with analytics, reporting, and integration platforms.
  
  
Understand and troubleshoot Oracle EBS architecture, including application tiers, concurrent processing, database connectivity, interfaces, responsibilities, and access.
  
  
Support scheduled EBS processes and reporting integrations.
  
  
Diagnose failures involving Oracle EBS-dependent reports, interfaces, scheduled processes, or output delivery.
  
  
Collaborate with EBS application, database, middleware, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
  
  
Provide architectural guidance for Oracle EBS reporting and analytics integrations.
  
  
Linux Platform Administration
  
  
Provide Linux administration support for Oracle Analytics and Middleware workloads.
  
  
Troubleshoot operating-system-level issues affecting OAS, OBIEE, WebLogic, and associated Oracle services.
  
  
Monitor CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, process, and network utilization.
  
  
Manage filesystem permissions, service accounts, environment configurations, scripts, and platform dependencies.
  
  
Collaborate with Linux engineering teams on operating-system patching, vulnerabilities, capacity, and platform lifecycle activities.
  
  
Patching Lifecycle Management
  
  
Plan, coordinate, implement, and validate Oracle Critical Patch Updates (CPU) and platform patches.
  
  
**Perform and support patching for:**  
Oracle Analytics Server
  
  
OBIEE/OBI
  
  
Oracle Fusion Middleware
  
  
WebLogic
  
  
JDK/Java
  
  
Supporting Oracle platform components
  
  
Conduct pre-patch assessments, dependency analysis, backups, validation, and post-patch testing.
  
  
Develop rollback and recovery procedures for production changes.
  
  
Coordinate patching activities with application, database, Linux, security, and business teams.
  
  
Support vulnerability remediation and security-compliance initiatives.
  
  
Certificates, TLS Security
  
  
Administer and troubleshoot SSL/TLS certificates, keystores, Java truststores, and certificate chains.
  
  
Manage certificate renewals and associated configuration changes.
  
  
Troubleshoot TLS handshake, certificate validation, and trust-related issues.
  
  
Support authentication and authorization integrations.
  
  
Work with SSO, LDAP, and enterprise identity-provider solutions where applicable.
  
  
Collaborate with security and identity teams to remediate vulnerabilities and security findings.
  
  
Production Support Incident Management
  
  
Provide senior-level production support for business-critical Oracle Analytics and Middleware environments.
  
  
Lead incident triage and service-restoration activities for high-priority production incidents.
  
  
Perform root-cause analysis across analytics, middleware, Linux, database, network, identity, and application layers.
  
  
Correlate application, middleware, operating-system, and database logs to identify root causes.
  
  
Troubleshoot platform outages, performance degradation, failed reports, authentication problems, connectivity issues, and integration failures.
  
  
Develop permanent corrective actions for recurring production issues.
  
  
Coordinate resolution activities with Oracle Database, Linux, Network, Identity, Security, EBS, and application teams.
  
  
Performance Engineering
  
  
Analyze performance across the complete Oracle Analytics technology stack.
  
  
**Troubleshoot performance issues across:**  
OAS / OBIEE
  
  
BI Publisher
  
  
WebLogic / Fusion Middleware
  
  
Oracle Database
  
  
Linux operating systems
  
  
Network and infrastructure layers

Recommend and implement platform optimization measures.
  
  
Establish monitoring and performance baselines for critical services.

Patching activities

Credential rotation

Participate in DR testing and recovery exercises.
