Identify resilience gaps and recommend improvements.

Title: New Business Representative
Description:
Requisition ID # 175803
  
  
**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Department Overview
  
  
The Strategy and Growth functional area is dedicated to long-term strategic and infrastructure planning. With electricity demand expected to double over the next 15 years, we’re building an energy system of the future for the world’s fourth-largest economy. It includes Energy Policy and Procurement, Strategy and Innovation, Integrated Long-Term Planning, and the Commercial Growth Organization.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
This job is represented by Engineers and Scientists of California (ESC) and subject to collective bargaining.
  
  
This is a Beginning Level Classification. Additional consideration may be given to candidates who reside within 50 miles of the headquarters.
  
  
This position is charged with customer contact, project coordination, billing, and contract preparation in connection with less complex installation of new business gas and/or electric facilities. NBRs will not prepare job estimates. This does not preclude job owners from preparing invoices or contracts based on simplified charge methodology.
  
  
A New Business Representative may be assigned no more than 50% of their workload in SNBR-level jobs at the same time and must work under the guidance of a Senior New Business Representative or IPE.
  
  
Employees hired into this classification from outside the bargaining unit will not have their bids or transfers considered under the provisions of title 21 for a period of 24 months following their employment date (“employment date” means the date placed into the regular classification, not date of hire with PG&E if different)
  
  
Employees in this classification may still bid to higher classifications in the same line of progression while still within the 24-month period.
  
  
This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory.
  
  
PG&E is providing the hourly rate that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This position is subject to collectively bargained hourly wage rates and increases. The starting wage rate for this position is $51.01 per hour. This wage rate is specific to the locality of the job. The wage rate is based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
SAFETY
  
Maximize public and employee safety by ensuring that job designs are performed to Company and State standards and meet all compliance requirements.
  
  
PROJECT MANAGEMENT
  
Prepares pre-design job packages with all required information including field sketch layouts for the scoping of construction and accurate field data including pictures measurements.
  
Manages scope and schedule and cost for all assigned projects, from initiation to meter set.
  
Coordinates all other departments or individuals who are involved with the project and works to define the project’s background, objective, design scope, schedule, roles, and responsibilities.
  
Coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to complete the project in a timely manner. Includes understanding of project schedules and working closely with the work and resource group to prioritize work using available tools or technology.
  
Proactively manages a new business portfolio of work to ensure compliance to standard work or ensures variances are in accordance with company guidelines. Effectively monitors project schedule and prioritizes work in coordination with dependency partners and construction execution teams.
  
Schedules and conducts project meetings, provides all pertinent data and addresses potential project risks including schedule setbacks and coordinates actions before setbacks occur.
  
Ensures that project is performed as planned or manages project delays in accordance with company guidelines.
  
Looks for ways to minimize costs on projects for both the applicant and PG&E.
  
Ensures that the correct type of financial order, work category, etc., has been applied and actively monitors costs.
  
  
FIELDING
  
Fielding including job site visits and customer meetings are required. Fielding will include but not limited to site visits for pre-design job package creation. facilitating pre-construction meetings, verifying site readiness and any emergent issues that might require a site visit.
  
NBRs will gather information on field conditions for pre-design packages for single locations. A single location is defined as one or more of the following:
  
**a. Electric:** Nearest point of electric distribution to panel, service work only if within 200 feet for Under Ground (UG) or 150 Over Head (OH).
  
**b. Gas:** Nearest point of gas distribution main to single meter location, service work only, if within 200 feet.
  
If a and/or b occurs more than once within a single premise, NBRs will field these as well (Example: House and Pump). At all other locations, the Job Owners Checklist is required, and the Field Notes Template is optional for each NBR, who will consult with their assigned mentor or supervisor as to whether collecting that information will be efficient.
  
  
COMMUNICATION
  
Communicates project status (e.g., scope, schedule, and cost) to all stakeholders throughout the project, as applicable.
  
Facilitates resolution of project-related disputes. Continuous formal communication (both written and verbal) with all stakeholders is given a high priority throughout all stages of the project.
  
Prepares contracts, as applicable, to ensure compliance with standards and tariffs.
  
Provides applicants, estimating, engineering, clerical and construction partners with complete and accurate information on rate and rule applicability, potential costs and timelines.
  
  
MANAGING CUSTOMER EXPECTATIONS
  
Proactively communicates to project stakeholders, both internal and external.
  
Negotiates reasonable estimating and construction dates that address customer’s anticipated schedules and meets compliance requirements, including communications and timelines. May provide customer with an initial non-binding cost.
  
  
TARIFFS
  
Ensures that all charges mandated under the applicable tariffs are identified in the contract and secured before beginning construction. This position is responsible for ensuring correct tariff interpretation and application, and for working with Law department on exceptional case projects when required.
  
Partner with other PG&E departments and/or rates and tariffs for application of best rates when appropriate.
  
  
COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT
  
Ensures all applicable project documentation is maintained in the system of record.
  
Ensures all project dependencies are met prior to allowing a construction start.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelor’s degree from a recognized college or its equivalent experience. Such experience must include three (3) or more years of experience in construction project management or PG&E technical service planning or 12 months of experience as a Hiring Hall (HH) New Business Representative, HH Senior New Business Representative and/or HH Engineering Estimator
  
Must have strong project management, customer contact and communications skills. Basic computer skills including Microsoft Word, Excel, email.
  
Valid California Driver's License and California minimum insurance coverage if using personal car
  
Driving is an essential function of this job, therefore the employee must have and maintain a valid driver’s license.
  
  
**Desired:**  
Additional consideration may be given to candidates that reside within 50 miles of the headquarters
  
Must have strong project management, customer contact and communications skills. Basic computer skills including Microsoft Word, Excel, email.
  
Familiar with tariffs, rates, contracts/tools, Work Management (WM) SAP and work processes and tools.
  
Works effectively as a member of a team
  
Ability to work with both internal and external customers/clients
  
Facilitation and conflict resolution skills
  
Ability to manage for results and in the process work as a team to build agreement
  
Strong focus on safety
  
Committed to providing superior and proactive customer service
  
Strong verbal and written communication skills
  
Ability to demonstrate initiative and decisiveness
  
Ability to demonstrate sound judgment and forward thinking
  
Problem solving skills
  
Computer skills (SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, etc.)
  
Conflict resolution skills
  
Measurement skills and ability to use some physical tools (drive stake in the ground, use Range Finder or Height Stick and Shovel, etc.) in the field
  
  
**Pre-Employment Testing:**  
**Internal PG&E Employees :** Qualified on the Physical Test Battery (PTB) and Work Orientation Inventory (WOI) prior to applying
  
**External and Hiring Hall Candidates :** Qualified on the Physical Test Battery (PTB) and Work Orientation Inventory (WOI) prior to interviewing

Title: ELV & Starlink Installation Technician
Description:
**About Starway Link**

Starway Link is a UAE telecom and infrastructure company headquartered in Deira, Dubai. We install Starlink satellite dish antennas for business customers as a Starlink installation subcontractor, and deliver ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems for offices, retail outlets and commercial buildings. Starway Link is a SIRA-approved contractor for CCTV supply and installation.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on installation technician to carry out Starlink satellite installations and ELV works at customer sites. The technician will survey sites, install and terminate equipment, configure and test systems, hand over to the customer, and complete all job documentation (work order completion forms, photos and test records). The role needs someone who is safe working at height, neat with cabling, comfortable dealing with customers, and able to work independently on site.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Starlink Installation***

* Conduct site surveys using the Starlink app to check for a clear sky view, obstructions and the best mounting position.
* Install Starlink dishes on roofs, walls, poles and parapets using the correct mounts (pole, wall, pivot, non-penetrating ridgeline or ballast).
* Route, protect and seal outdoor cables; drill and seal wall penetrations properly to prevent water ingress.
* Install and configure the Starlink router, power supply and, where required, Ethernet adapters, mesh units or third-party routers and switches.
* Activate and test the service: signal, speed test, Wi-Fi coverage and connected devices. Explain basic use to the customer.
* Complete the work order completion form and before/after photos for each job and get the customer's sign-off.
* Attend service calls for relocation, obstruction issues, cable faults and equipment replacement.

***ELV Systems***

* **CCTV:** Install IP cameras, NVRs, PoE switches and monitors; configure recording, remote viewing (mobile app) and user accounts. Follow SIRA requirements for camera coverage, recording retention and documentation.
* **Structured cabling:** Pull, terminate and label Cat6/Cat6A cables; install patch panels, racks and cabinets; test and certify links.
* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.
* **Access control & intercom:** Install readers, electric locks, exit buttons, controllers and video intercoms; enrol users and test.
* Read and work from layout drawings and BOQs; mark up as-built changes.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on existing ELV systems.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

**Salary**

* To be decided in interview

Pay: From AED3,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Chief of Support Services
Description:
Job Responsibilities
  
  
The South Carolina Legislative Services Agency (LSA) is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief of Support Services Manager to lead and oversee all service-oriented operations supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. This position provides executive-level leadership support services including service desk, media support, legislative process, and information management and training, all within a non-partisan and apolitical environment.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager is accountable for ensuring exceptional customer service delivery across all support services by providing reliable, intuitive, and secure technology and operational support. This role is responsible for reducing service friction, improving user experience, and ensuring that service outcomes are measurable, transparent, and aligned with legislative business needs.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager serves as a trusted advisor to agency leadership and plays a critical role in aligning service delivery and operational planning with the mission and strategic goals of LSA. This role blends leadership, operational oversight, business analysis, and will work closely with project management to ensure high-quality, efficient, and innovative support services for the House of Representatives, Senate, and Legislative Council.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for all support services departments, ensuring streamlined, reliable, and responsive operations.
* Serve as the senior authority for service management initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, and execution of operational and technology-related services.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Agency Director on service delivery, operational effectiveness, organizational readiness, and change management.
* Lead and manage cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct comprehensive business, workflow, and service function analyses, including needs assessments and change impact evaluations.
* Define, recommend, and implement operational and service improvements using best-practice business processes and methodologies.
* Collaborate with the Senior Project Management lead for major agency initiatives, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and reporting to executive leadership.
* Lead the planning and implementation of special initiatives to support legislative bodies as they adapt to new technologies, methodologies, and lifecycle replacements.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, service frameworks, performance metrics, and improvement workflows.
* Partner with division and team managers to identify current and future projects, resource needs, and service priorities.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, service excellence, innovation, and accountability across all support services functions.
* Ensure all activities support the mission of LSA in a non-political, non-partisan, and behind-the-scenes capacity.

**Customer Service Delivery & Excellence**

* Ensure support services operate with a customer-first mindset, delivering reliable, intuitive, and secure services that meet the needs of legislative staff and stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in user experience by reducing service friction, improving response times, and proactively addressing recurring issues.
* Translate technical and operational decisions into clear business value that users can understand and experience.
* Own major service incidents and escalations end-to-end, ensuring timely communication, resolution, and post-incident review to prevent repeat occurrences.
* Serve as a visible, calm, and credible leader during service disruptions, setting expectations and communicating status, impacts, and resolutions in clear, non-technical language.
* Define, implement, and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to measure service reliability, responsiveness, and quality.
* Balance speed, quality, security, and compliance when delivering services and making operational decisions.
* Collect and analyze user feedback, service trends, and performance data to proactively improve services before issues escalate.
* Champion automation, self-service tools, and process improvements that enhance efficiency while maintaining service quality.

**Management & Leadership Responsibilities**

* Build, mentor, and retain high-performing service-oriented teams with a strong emphasis on professionalism, accountability, and customer service excellence.
* Coach staff in both technical competencies and soft skills, including communication, empathy, and stakeholder engagement.
* Establish clear roles, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability across support services teams.
* Act as the final escalation point for vendors and third-party partners, ensuring service commitments and performance expectations are met.

Manage service-related budgets and resources responsibly, justifying expenditures through demonstrated service outcomes
  
  
**Minimum And Additional Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, computer science, information management, or another IT or business-related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in:

+ IT business analysis
+ Project or program management
+ Personnel or team leadership

**Additional Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of business analysis techniques, needs assessments, and change management principles.
* Strong leadership and personnel management skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and develop teams.
* Advanced support services skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through completion.
* Exceptional planning, facilitation, communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Ability to understand both high-level strategic objectives and detailed operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict management skills.
* Proficiency in SharePoint, Microsoft Office, and IT support services methodologies, with demonstrated adaptability and a willingness to learn and support emerging AI technologies and models as the agency evolves.
* Excellent written communication skills for executive reporting, technical documentation, and professional correspondence.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a professional appearance and demeanor.
* Ability to logically analyze complex problems and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
* Ability to set priorities based on the unique needs of the House, Senate, and Legislative Council.
* Must be personable, polite, respectful, flexible, open-minded, and non-judgmental.
* Must be comfortable working in a non-political, behind-the-scenes support role.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to balance user expectations, operational constraints, and organizational priorities.
* Proven ability to explain complex technical or operational issues in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, escalations, and service recovery in high-visibility environments.
* Ability to make decisive, accountable decisions under pressure while maintaining professionalism and trust.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification (must be certified within a year of hire)
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green belt or higher).
* Experience working in a legislative, judicial, or government agency environment.

Experience establishing or improving
**service metrics, SLAs, KPIs, and performance dashboards**
Additional Comments
  
  
This is an onsite position operating within a professional government environment supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. The role requires frequent collaboration with executive leadership, technical teams, and service-oriented departments while maintaining strict non-partisanship and political neutrality. The work is mission-driven, service-focused, and essential to effective legislative operations. Success in this role requires a customer-first mindset, strong decision-making under pressure, clear and consistent communication, accountability and empathy for both service users and staff.
  
  
**Benefits For State Employees**
The state of South Carolina offers eligible employees generous benefits, including health and dental insurance; retirement and savings plan options; and paid vacation and sick leave. Plus, work-life balance programs such as telecommuting and flexible work schedules are available to employees of some state agencies.
  
  
**Insurance Benefits**
Eligible employees may enroll in health insurance, which includes prescription coverage and wellness benefits. Other available insurance benefits include dental, vision, term life insurance, long term disability and flexible spending accounts for health and child care expenses.
  
  
**Retirement Benefits**
State employees are also offered retirement plan options, including defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Additionally, eligible employees may elect to participate in the South Carolina Deferred Compensation Program, which is a voluntary, supplemental retirement savings plan offering 401(k) and 457 plan options.
  
  
**Workplace Benefits**
State employees may also be eligible for other benefits, including tuition assistance; holiday, annual and sick leave; and discounts on purchases, travel and more.
  
  
**Note:**
The benefits above are available to most state employees, with the exception of those in temporary positions. Employees in temporary grant and time-limited positions may be eligible for all, some or none of these benefits as benefits are associated with each position type. For these positions, contact the hiring agency to determine what benefits may be available.

Title: Chargé(e) princ de projet Bilingue, Exploitation, Payeurs-fournisseurs
Description:
**Description**

À titre de chargé de projet principal ou de chargée de projet principale dans l’équipe de gestion de projet de l’exploitation payeur-fournisseur de TELUS Santé, vous serez responsable de la mise en œuvre complexe de systèmes de santé aux enjeux importants qui ont une incidence directe sur les clients de partout au Canada. * Diriger des projets complexes dans notre portefeuille d’exploitation de payeurs-fournisseurs, qu’il s’agisse de solutions de DME, de gestion des régimes d’assurance maladie ou de mise en œuvre de systèmes de Solutions en pharmacie. * Bilinguisme (français et anglais)
* Un baccalauréat en administration, en informatique, en soins de santé ou dans une discipline connexe

* Aptitude avérée à travailler de manière autonome, avec un minimum de supervision, tout en gérant de nombreuses priorités concurrentes sous pression et en respectant des échéances fixes
* Maîtrise avancée de la mise en œuvre de systèmes de soins de santé avec une compréhension démontrée des systèmes de santé, de la complexité de l’exploitation et des répercussions sur les soins aux patients
* Solides compétences en leadership, y compris la prise de décisions, la capacité d’influencer sans autorité officielle et la gestion des attentes des parties prenantes dans des environnements matriciels
* Expertise démontrée dans la gestion de l’ambiguïté et la mise en œuvre de méthodes de gestion du changement et de pensée axée sur les systèmes
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes à un éventail de publics (du personnel clinique à la haute direction)

**Atouts**

* Diplôme d’études supérieures en administration des affaires, en gestion des soins de santé ou dans un domaine connexe
* Formation avancée ou certification en gestion du changement et en science de la mise en œuvre

Une connaissance avancée de l'anglais est requise, car vous serez appelé(e) la plupart du temps à interagir en anglais avec des parties externes (par ex. clients, fournisseurs ou partenaires externes); à interagir en anglais avec des parties internes (par ex. collègues ou parties prenantes); et à travailler dans un environnement informatique anglais dans le cadre des tâches liées à ce poste dont la portée est nationale.

A World leader in air cargo. We possess a geographical advantage that enables us to reach over 140 destinations across 6 continents. state-of-the-a

rt, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs.

Undertake the management of other aspects of Freighter Department including **charter-related system requirements** .

  Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with other Emirates operational departments ensuring that they are provided in a timely manner and that Emirates is capable of fulfilling them. This also requires checking back with the operator to ensure that the operator's planning information reflect Emirates requirements **for both freighter and charter operations** .

  When special charter flights are operated, the job holder is required to travel to outstations, especially off-line stations and/or stations that do not have freighter expertise, to ensure all operational activity in relation to the charter is performed according to company standards and customer's satisfaction.

  **Support the operational planning and coordination of ad-hoc charter flights, ensuring all stakeholder requirements are met before, during and after operation.**

  **Prepare analysis and reporting on charter performance, operational efficiency and profitability to support management decision-making.**

Should have completed approved Cargo Acceptance and Handling courses including Special Cargo Handling and Acceptance, Cargo Product Knowledge, Advanced Load Control and Freighter Load Control.

Excellent communication & IT skills.

Title: Agent Associate, Family and Consumer Sciences Educator (Nutrition and Health)
Description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Organization's Summary Statement:
  
University of Maryland Extension (UME) is a statewide, non-formal education system within the College of Agriculture and Natural Resources and the University of Maryland Eastern Shore.
  
  
UME educational programs and problem-solving assistance are available to citizens and are based on the research and experience of land grant universities such as the University of Maryland, College Park.
  
  
In Maryland, UME employs approximately 200 faculty and approximately 200 support staff and contractual employees located at the University of Maryland, College Park; University of Maryland Eastern Shore; 23 counties; Baltimore City; and four research and education centers. Many UME faculty members located on the College Park and Eastern Shore campuses have joint appointments with research and academic programs. These joint appointments promote the exchange of knowledge between the universities and among academic specialties.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY:
  
Family and Consumer Sciences (FCS) is a people-centered discipline that supports individuals, families, and communities in navigating the challenges of a complex world. As part of the University of Maryland Extension, the FCS program advances human health, well-being, and economic stability for Maryland residents across the lifespan through evidence-based education, research, outreach, and technology. FCS programming addresses the prevention and reduction of the burden of chronic disease by providing education on nutrition, healthy food choices, safe food handling, and mental and behavioral health. The program also promotes economic and workforce development by strengthening essential life skills, including budgeting, goal-oriented saving, and understanding health insurance. FCS engages adults, youth, farmers, schools, businesses, and community organizations in both rural and urban settings. Through these coordinated efforts, FCS helps people build the knowledge, skills, and confidence to make informed decisions, reduce health and financial risks, and improve quality of life statewide.
  
  
This position, Agent Associate (FCS Educator – Nutrition and Health), provides Nutrition, Health, and Wellness programming to UME-Prince George’s County in Capital Cluster, Maryland. This position will provide leadership and delivery of impactful educational programming related to nutrition, food, chronic disease prevention and management, health, food access, and food safety and preservation. This position will also create and facilitate community partnerships with local and state agencies, nonprofit organizations, school systems, healthcare providers, businesses, and other entities that support extension programs centered on human health through innovative educational approaches. The Agent Associate will be a Professional-Track (PTK) faculty member and is eligible for promotion to a higher rank in accordance with university policy and UME PTK guidelines. In carrying out these duties, the educator is responsible to the FCS Program Leader for programmatic leadership.  
  
  
  
Physical Demands:
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
  

* Nature of the Position: This position frequently presents information through vocal and written communication to individuals of various ages, socio-economic, and educational backgrounds.
* Physical Demands: A routine part of this position's responsibilities would be to transport materials to and from teaching and event locations, including loading and unloading the vehicle. The employee will frequently lift and/or move items weighing up to 20 pounds. Set-up and teardown of displays, tables, and chairs would be necessary at many teaching sites.
* Environmental: Team driven, office environment of professional character, competence, and collaboration. Deadline driven in terms of program planning and reporting. This position may require the employee to work in community or school environments, as well as outdoors at certain times of the year, such as county fairs.
* Visual Acuity: Visual acuity is required for preparing and analyzing written or computer data and presentations.

  
QUALIFICATIONS:
  
Required-
  

* Bachelor’s degree in nutrition, health or other closely related field.
* Experience in educational program development and the evaluation process.
* Evidence of knowledge and ability to effectively communicate and engage with clientele.
* Demonstrated evidence of excellent teaching and communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience in personnel management, financial administration, budget preparation, and organizational or program coordination.
* Ability to think independently yet work successfully as a member of a cohesive team
* Demonstrated ability to develop successful community collaborations and partnerships.
* Strong computer skills and experience with Google Mail system, Microsoft Office, Zoom, and other software to support program development, management, delivery, and evaluation.
* Demonstrated program management, organization, and time management skills.
* Commitment to lifelong learning and professional development.
* Must become a certified food handling educator and obtain ServSafe certification within six (6) months of hire.
* Personal transportation and a valid driver's license are required. Must be willing to travel throughout the cluster as well as the state of Maryland as needed.
* Flexible work schedule required for delivering evening and weekend educational programs and activities as determined by clientele availability and needs.
* This position is subject to a Criminal History Record Check and University of Maryland Background check. Employment is contingent upon successful completion and clearance of the Criminal History Record Check.

  
Preferred-

* Extension or similar work experience in formal or non-formal community-based education.
* Ability and experience in using social media and marketing strategies to engage clientele.
* Demonstrated ability in generating funds such as grants, contracts, and donations to enhance extension outreach programming
* Experience working with broad audiences and all socioeconomic levels.

Title: Extension Educator, Ruminant Livestock Specialist
Description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Organization's Summary Statement:
  
  
University of Maryland Extension (UME) invites applications for a 12-month tenure-track position of Agent to conduct applied research, provide educational programming, and offer expertise in beef and dairy cattle and small ruminant production to producers, agricultural service providers, and UME personnel throughout Maryland. Specifically, the Extension Specialist will provide leadership and delivery of educational programming related to ruminant livestock production systems, and ruminant health and nutrition. Program areas may include physiology and reproduction; herd evaluation; animal health, comfort, and welfare; facilities design and management; livestock equipment evaluation; animal nutrition; feeding systems; forage production; pasture and grazing management; environmental management, or other topics.
  
  
The applicant will have access to Maryland Agricultural Experiment Station facilities including dairy, beef, small ruminant, and equine facilities with 600 acres of forage crops. The Extension Specialist will facilitate partnerships with university colleagues, local and state agencies, elected officials, communities, landowners, producers, and industry groups in facilitating implementation of best practices related to livestock production and management. The incumbent will also serve as the Maryland representative for regional beef and dairy cattle and small ruminant production information and training efforts. The position will be based at the Western Maryland Research and Education Center near Keedysville, Maryland.  
  
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  
The Extension Specialist will be part of a broad team (College of Agriculture and Natural Resources, UME, and key stakeholder groups) that conducts applied research and educational programming to improve the production and management of beef and dairy cattle and small ruminant systems in Maryland. The position will provide leadership for relevant ruminant livestock programming within the Agriculture and Food Systems Program, one of four UME programs. The individual will collaborate closely with producers, field and campus Extension colleagues, state and federal agencies, industry representatives, agricultural leaders, and other stakeholders to address important issues in ruminant livestock systems.
  
  
The incumbent will conduct needs assessments to identify research and education program priorities of targeted audiences. The Extension Specialist will also be responsible for working intentionally and collaboratively to increase the visibility and reach of UME programs through educational programming designed to meet the needs of all audiences. The position will interpret and disseminate the latest research findings using a variety of delivery and communication strategies appropriate for intended target audiences including, but not limited to, workshops, classes, demonstration projects, webcasts, social media, publications, mass media, and community coalitions. The position will also help support youth development programs related to ruminant livestock production systems.
  
  
The Extension Specialist will use entrepreneurial practices to secure grants, contracts, program fees, partnerships, and sponsorships to develop a robust Extension program that delivers, measures, and interprets the impacts of programs and engagements regarding livestock production systems in Maryland and beyond. Innovative strategies and cutting-edge teaching and learning methods will be used to design, develop, deliver, and evaluate programs for a robust Extension education program that engages participants in a collaborative-learning environment and encourages adoption of research-based information in decision-making.

Title: Salesforce Architect
Description:
**Position Title: Salesforce Solution Architect**

**Department: Vibrant Technology**

**Reports to: CRM Director**

**Location: Remote**

**Schedule: M-F, 35 hours (Full-Time)**

**Travel: >5%**

**Salary: $80,000 - $131,000**

  

Formerly the Mental Health Association of New York City (MHA-NYC), Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high-quality services and support, when, where, and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state-of-the-art technology-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.

  
  

**Position Overview:**

Vibrant is seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to provide solution architecture leadership across Vibrant’s Salesforce CRM platforms. Reporting directly to the CRM Director, this role translates business and product needs into secure, scalable, maintainable Salesforce solutions while protecting long-term platform health. The Solution Architect works closely with CRM engineers, CRM administrators, Product, Delivery, Data, Security, DevSecOps, QA, vendors, and systems integrators to guide solution design, identify dependencies and downstream impacts, and establish reusable architecture patterns and standards.

  
  

This is a senior individual-contributor role and does not replace hands-on engineering leadership. The Solution Architect owns solution architecture and major technical design decisions, while CRM engineering leads remain accountable for engineering execution, code quality, mentoring, and implementation. Consistent with an agile delivery model, the architect enables teams to make sound decisions quickly and focuses formal review on changes with meaningful architectural, security, integration, data, or cross-platform impact.

  
  

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Lead Salesforce solution architecture across CRM platforms, including application, data, integration, security, automation, and platform design.
* Translate prioritized business requirements and product outcomes into scalable technical solution options, documenting tradeoffs, constraints, assumptions, risks, and recommendations.
* Partner with CRM engineers during technical discovery and solutioning so engineering input is incorporated before work is committed to a sprint.
* Review proposed Salesforce solutions for scalability, maintainability, reuse, performance, security, data integrity, integration impact, and alignment with platform standards.
* Define and maintain reusable Salesforce architecture patterns, design standards, technical guardrails, and reference approaches.
* Perform impact and dependency analysis across Salesforce objects, fields, automation, Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, APIs, reporting, security, identity, and downstream systems.
* Architect integration solutions between Salesforce and SaaS, custom, cloud, or on-premises applications using REST APIs, event-driven patterns, middleware, custom connectors, and web services.
* Partner with Data, Security, Identity, DevSecOps, and other enterprise technology teams when solutions cross CRM boundaries or require specialized review.
* Provide architectural direction for new Salesforce capabilities, major platform changes, modernization initiatives, technical debt remediation, and new tools or vendor solutions affecting the CRM ecosystem.
* Evaluate when declarative configuration, custom development, integration, or another platform capability is the most appropriate solution; avoid unnecessary customization and duplication.
* Support architectural review of major data-model changes, security-sensitive designs, cross-platform integrations, enterprise shared components, and difficult-to-reverse technical decisions.
* Manage and collaborate with product vendors and systems integrators; review proposed designs and ensure external solutions align with Vibrant’s Salesforce architecture and engineering standards.
* Partner with CRM engineering leadership on DevSecOps, source control, CI/CD, testing, deployment, code-quality, and platform-reliability standards where architectural direction is required.
* Support root cause analysis for significant platform incidents and identify architectural or design changes needed to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain state-of-the-art awareness of Salesforce capabilities, releases, architecture guidance, security features, integration patterns, and emerging platform technologies.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the Salesforce landscape, retire redundant customization, increase reuse, reduce technical debt, and improve platform sustainability.
* Create and maintain solution architecture documentation, architecture decision records, integration diagrams, data-flow diagrams, design patterns, and technical artifacts for the CRM knowledge base.
* Contribute lessons learned and approved architectural patterns to the Salesforce Center of Excellence so teams can reuse knowledge and make future decisions faster.
* Support small, testable, iterative solution approaches and rapid feedback rather than over-designing solutions before teams have validated the need.
  

  

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, architectural decisions, tradeoffs, and risks effectively with engineers, management, product teams, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, configuration, custom development, security, data architecture, automation, and integration.
* Ability to design scalable Salesforce solutions spanning multiple applications, integrations, and business processes.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, Salesforce security and sharing, data modeling, APIs, asynchronous processing, integration patterns, and platform limits.
* Ability to architect, review, and support integrations between Salesforce and SaaS, custom, cloud, or on-premises applications using REST APIs, event-driven patterns, middleware, custom connectors, and web services.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration, identity/access, data governance, security, DevSecOps, CI/CD, source control, testing, and release-management concepts as they relate to Salesforce.
* Ability to identify downstream impacts and dependencies before implementation and recommend practical mitigation strategies.
* Ability to write clear technical specifications, solution designs, architecture decision records, diagrams, and standards.
* Ability to facilitate technical decision-making without becoming an unnecessary approval bottleneck.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills in an evolving, complex, and fast-paced environment.
  

  

**Decision Making:**

* Makes Salesforce solution architecture decisions within established enterprise technology, security, data, and governance standards.
* Evaluates multiple solution approaches and recommends the option that best balances business value, delivery speed, maintainability, security, scalability, and long-term platform health.
* Determines when a solution can proceed within established Salesforce patterns and when broader enterprise architecture, security, data, or governance review is required.
* May reject or redirect proposed technical designs that create unacceptable architectural, security, data-integrity, integration, maintainability, or downstream risk.
* Escalates enterprise-wide technology decisions that extend beyond the Salesforce domain to the appropriate enterprise authority.
* Provides architectural guidance while preserving engineering teams’ ability to make routine implementation decisions within approved patterns.
  

  

**Scope of Responsibility/Accountability:**

* Accountable for Salesforce solution architecture quality across assigned CRM platforms and major initiatives.
* Establishes architecture patterns and technical standards that can be reused across CRM teams and product pods.
* Provides architectural oversight for complex projects, integrations, modernization efforts, and significant platform changes.
* Partners with CRM engineering leadership to ensure approved designs are implemented consistently and technical risks are addressed.
* Maintains architecture artifacts and contributes platform knowledge to the Salesforce Center of Excellence.
* Monitors architectural risks, technical debt, and platform constraints and recommends corrective or modernization plans when needed.
  

  

**Managing/Directing Work:**

* Provides technical direction and architectural guidance to CRM engineers, administrators, vendors, and systems integrators without serving as their day-to-day people manager.
* Facilitates architecture and design discussions, establishes decision boundaries, and helps teams reach technically sound decisions efficiently.
* Mentors engineers and technical leads in solution design, architecture patterns, impact analysis, and technical decision-making.
* Coordinates specialized technical input from Security, Data, DevSecOps, Identity, and other teams when required by the solution.
* Manages architecture work and priorities with minimal supervision and balances planned architecture activities with time-sensitive delivery needs.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and at least 8 years of experience in Salesforce/CRM engineering, solution architecture, software engineering, or a similar role; additional relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
* At least 3 years of demonstrated experience designing complex Salesforce solutions or serving in a Salesforce technical/solution architecture capacity.
* Experience supporting large-scale Salesforce implementations, integrations, upgrades, and production environments.
* Hands-on Salesforce implementation, development, administration, maintenance, and optimization experience.
* Demonstrated experience with Salesforce integration architecture, security, data modeling, automation, and custom development.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required.
* Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Integration Architect, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect, or comparable advanced Salesforce architecture certification strongly preferred.

Title: Specialist - Schedules Planning

* Develops and maintains operationally robust schedules across the relevant planning windows, ensuring alignment with the approved Operating Plan and available aircraft, crew and maintenance resources.
* Oversees schedule changes within the tactical planning window and coordinates implementation with Network Control, Engineering Planning, Crew Planning, Airport Services, outstations and Commercial teams.

* Coordinates cargo schedule requirements with Cargo, Flight Operations, Engineering, Network Control, Crew Planning, Airport Services, Ground Handling and relevant outstations before implementation.

* Loads, validates and publishes approved cargo flights through Sabre AirVision, the Corporate Schedules Repository and applicable downstream schedule distribution processes, including the required SSIM messages.
* Manages amendments to published cargo schedules, checking the impact on aircraft rotations, slots and approvals and ensuring changes are accurately communicated to systems and operational stakeholders.

Title: SVP, IT Operations
Description:
**SUMMARY**

The Senior Vice President, IT Operations is accountable for the stability, performance, resilience, secure operation and continuous improvement of the technology environment that supports BGIS operations and the business-critical solutions we deliver to our clients. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this executive leads four operational domains: Application Support, Infrastructure (including Service Desk and End User Support), Financial Application Support, and the Legacy Software Development Platform (operational enhancements). The individual sets the operational strategy and service model for these domains, directs a team of directors, managers and technical professionals across onshore and offshore teams, and partners with business unit leaders, client-facing teams and vendors to ensure that services meet or exceed contractual SLAs and client expectations. The individual drives a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement, using automation, standardization, data-driven KPI management and modern IT service management practices to increase reliability, reduce cost, and improve the client and end-user experience. The role is a member of the IT leadership team and reports regularly to senior and executive management on operational performance, risk and investment priorities.

**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Leadership

Directs the IT Operations organization through a team of directors and managers, spanning onshore, offshore and third-party resources across all four domains.

Demonstrates strong, competent leadership for team members to guide them in reaching their full potential and meeting their objectives, which supports achievement of our corporate goals. Specifically, these responsibilities include but not limited to:

* Full involvement with recruiting talent.
* Provides mentoring, coaching and guidance to all team members.
* Objectively recommends compensation adjustments.
* Manages all aspects of performance.
* Builds leadership bench strength and succession plans across all four IT Operations domains.
* Develops the technical capabilities of the organization, including reskilling and upskilling staff for cloud, automation and AI-enabled operations.
* Defines the workforce and sourcing strategy, determining the right balance of in-house, offshore and managed service resources.
Fosters an environment of teamwork, accountability, innovation and client service to meet business objectives.  

IT Operations Strategy & Service Excellence

* Defines and executes the multi-year IT Operations strategy and roadmap, aligned with BGIS business objectives, client commitments and the broader IT strategy.
* Partners with the Chief Technology Officer and Architecture to shape the enterprise technology roadmap and standards, and leads the operational integration of acquired businesses and new technology platforms.
* Holds overall accountability for the availability, performance and resiliency of business-critical solutions that support our clients, ensuring contractual SLAs and KPIs are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establishes a unified operating model, service catalogue and support structure (L1-L3) across Application Support, Infrastructure, Financial Application Support and the Legacy Software Development Platform.
* Establishes demand intake, prioritization and resource capacity planning across all four domains, balancing day-to-day operations, operational projects, CISO-requested security work and client commitments, and ensures operational projects are delivered on time, on budget and with minimal service disruption.
* Establishes governance for ITSM processes, including incident, major incident, problem, change, release, configuration and request management, and ensures timely root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Ensures 24x7 operational coverage for business-critical services, including monitoring and event management, and on-call and after-hours support.
* Serves as the executive escalation point for critical client-impacting incidents; directs response, client communication and post-incident reviews.
* Builds relationships with senior business unit leaders and client-facing teams to understand business direction, anticipate operational needs and manage expectations.
* Provides service performance insights to account and client-facing teams to inform client governance discussions and shape the support model, and ensures IT services comply with client contractual, audit and data protection requirements.
* Establishes and enforces IT Operations policies, standards and procedures, and ensures adherence to enterprise IT standards (i.e. Security, IT Governance, Service Management, Architecture).
* Manages operational risks through mitigation strategies, and plans or implements contingencies where necessary.
Provides regular reporting to senior and executive management on SLA and KPI performance, operational risk, capacity and investment priorities.  

Application Support

* Directs the support, maintenance and operational health of the enterprise and client-facing application portfolio, including integrations, middleware and SaaS platforms.
* Ensures applications that support client service delivery are monitored, supported and maintained to meet defined service levels and business continuity requirements.
* Partners with Business Technology, product and development teams to ensure smooth transition of new solutions into production support, including defining operational acceptance criteria early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Sets the strategy for application lifecycle management, including patching, upgrades, license compliance, and the rationalization and decommissioning of redundant applications.
Oversees database administration and data operations, including performance, backup and restore, and data retention, in line with BGIS and client requirements.  

Infrastructure & End User Support

* Leads the strategy, engineering and operation of the infrastructure environment, including data centre and cloud platforms, servers, storage, networks and telephony.
* Directs the Service Desk and End User Support functions, including end-user computing, mobile devices, collaboration tools and field support, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience for employees and client-facing staff.
* Ensures infrastructure capacity, performance and resiliency meet current and future business and client requirements.
* Owns IT disaster recovery and partners with the Business Continuity Planning (BCP) team to ensure IT systems meet BCP objectives; ensures DR plans are documented and tested regularly.
* Establishes IT asset and configuration management practices, including hardware and software asset lifecycle and an accurate configuration management database (CMDB).
Advances infrastructure modernization, including cloud adoption, observability, AIOps and infrastructure automation.  

Financial Application Support

* Directs the operation, support and operational enhancement of the financial application landscape (e.g. ERP, general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, billing, procurement and related integrations).
* Partners with Finance leadership to ensure financial systems reliably support month-end, quarter-end and year-end close, client billing and financial reporting cycles.
* Ensures appropriate IT general controls, segregation of duties and audit readiness in support of internal controls over financial reporting and internal and external audit requirements.
Establishes governance with Finance stakeholders for prioritizing financial system changes, enhancements and upgrades.  

Legacy Software Development Platform (Operational Enhancements)

* Leads the team responsible for sustaining and enhancing legacy and custom-developed software platforms that continue to support business-critical operations and client solutions.
* Establishes the intake and prioritization framework for operational enhancements, defect fixes and minor changes, balancing business value, risk and capacity.
* Ensures sound software change management practices, including source control, release and deployment management, testing, quality assurance and release sign-off.
Reduces technical debt and operational risk of legacy platforms, and partners with Architecture and Business Technology to define modernization, migration or retirement roadmaps.  

Security & Compliance Support

* Partners with the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), delivering the technology work required for security projects and programs as they are raised.
* Ensures operational security practices are consistently executed across IT Operations in accordance with CISO-defined policies, including access management, vulnerability and patch management, backup and secure configuration.
* Supports the CISO during security incidents by providing technical response, recovery and remediation resources.
Supports compliance, certification and client audit activities by providing operational evidence and remediating identified gaps.  

Continuous Improvement

* Champions a culture of continuous improvement, using operational data, trend analysis and client feedback to identify and remove recurring issues and inefficiencies.
* Drives automation, self-service, standardization and AI-enabled tooling to improve service quality, speed of resolution and cost-effectiveness.
* Ensures knowledge management, runbooks and documentation practices are maintained across all IT Operations domains to enable shift-left resolution, self-service and reduced reliance on key individuals.
* Establishes meaningful, business-focused KPIs and dashboards for each domain and uses them to set improvement targets and measure progress.
* Introduces and matures industry best practices (e.g. ITIL, Lean, SRE and DevOps principles) across IT Operations.
* Applies BGIS AI policies and establishes operating guidelines for the responsible use of AI and automation within IT Operations.
Evaluates emerging technologies and recommends investments that improve reliability, reduce risk and deliver value to our clients.  

Financial & Vendor Management

* Develops and manages the IT Operations operating and capital budgets; identifies opportunities for cost optimization while protecting service quality.
* Applies cloud financial management (FinOps) practices to monitor, allocate and optimize cloud consumption costs.
* Manages strategic vendor, managed service provider and outsourcing relationships, including contract negotiation, performance management and SLA governance.
* Ensures managed service providers, offshore and third-party resources meet BGIS and client security, privacy and contractual obligations, in partnership with the CISO and Procurement.
* Supports proposal and client transition teams by defining operational support models and service commitments, and ensures client data, access and integrations are transitioned or decommissioned in line with contractual obligations when client contracts end.
Other duties as assigned.  

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or equivalent; Master's Degree or MBA is an asset.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive IT experience, including at least 8 years in senior leadership roles within IT Operations, infrastructure and application support.
* Proven experience leading large, multi-disciplinary teams through multiple layers of management, including onshore, offshore and third-party resources.
* Demonstrated track record of supporting business-critical, client-facing solutions in a service delivery or outsourced services environment with contractual SLAs.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure (cloud, data centre, network, end-user computing), service desk operations, application support, and IT service management (ITIL) practices.
* Experience supporting financial/ERP systems and IT general controls in an audited environment.
* Working knowledge of security and privacy frameworks and regulations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, PIPEDA) as they apply to IT operations.
* Experience sustaining and modernizing legacy and custom-developed software platforms, including software change and release management.
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement, automation and operational transformation with measurable results.
* Exceptionally skilled business and financial management ability, including management of operating and capital budgets.
* Exceptionally skilled at influencing, negotiating and building relationships with senior management and executives.
* Highly skilled at managing vendor performance and complex service contracts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas in easy to understand business terms.
* Calm, decisive leadership under pressure, with the ability to direct response to major incidents.
Experience in the Real Estate or Facilities Management domain is desirable.  

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**

* ITIL certification is required (Expert or Managing Professional preferred).
PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or cloud platform certifications are an asset.  

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $230,000 - $265,000 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education, professional designations and performance related to this role.

We are seeking an experienced **Network Engineer** to manage, maintain, and operate the Ministry's network infrastructure across its headquarters and governorate branches.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, Cisco infrastructure, routing and switching, wireless LAN configuration, firewall administration, network monitoring, and information security.

The successful candidate will ensure network availability, performance, security, and operational continuity while supporting infrastructure improvements and technical operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Network Infrastructure & Administration**

* Manage daily network operations and technical activities related to IT infrastructure.
* Install, configure, operate, and maintain network switches, Cisco Wireless Controllers, and Cisco Voice Gateways.
* Configure and manage VLANs and perform necessary switch modifications.
* Manage Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols, routing, and switching.
* Monitor network connectivity, internet links, leased lines, and overall network performance.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to resolve connectivity issues.

**Wireless Networking & Security**

* Configure and maintain enterprise wireless networks using Cisco, Ruckus, and HP/Aruba technologies.
* Prepare and analyze passive and active Wi-Fi heatmaps.
* Monitor firewall operations, perform necessary updates, and ensure security configurations are maintained.
* Implement information security policies, technical circulars, and network security requirements.
* Manage and monitor network security devices and associated infrastructure.

**Network Monitoring & Communication Systems**

* Monitor and maintain Cisco Call Manager, IP telephony, billing systems, and video communication infrastructure.
* Monitor network devices and connectivity using Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.
* Monitor MPLS, leased lines, DSL connections, and other network links.
* Monitor UPS systems and backup batteries to prevent infrastructure interruptions.

**Backup, Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain secure backups of network devices and configurations before and after every major change.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including device configurations, connectivity details, and network diagrams using Microsoft Visio.
* Maintain updated infrastructure plans, network drawings, and operational documentation.
* Prepare monthly and on-demand technical reports covering assigned activities, incidents, and resolutions.

**Infrastructure Management & Knowledge Transfer**

* Supervise network infrastructure and server room operations.
* Identify potential network failures and implement preventive measures to ensure service continuity.
* Analyze network equipment specifications and recommend infrastructure improvements.
* Develop operational plans and organize technical tasks to ensure business continuity.
* Provide knowledge transfer, technical guidance, and training to the Ministry's IT staff.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Networking, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum **5+ years of professional experience** in Network Engineering / Network Administration.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols.
* Practical experience with routing and switching technologies, particularly Cisco and HP/Aruba.
* Strong experience configuring and managing enterprise wireless networks using Cisco, Ruckus, and HP/Aruba.
* Ability to prepare and analyze active and passive Wi-Fi heatmaps.
* Knowledge of structured cabling systems, including passive network infrastructure.
* Experience with MPLS, leased lines, DSL connections, and ISP coordination.
* Knowledge of Cisco IP Phones, Cisco Call Manager, and voice communication systems.
* Familiarity with Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.
* Experience with Cisco Firepower 5508 and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (1000-D, 501E, and 60E).
* Strong troubleshooting, network security, and infrastructure management skills.
* Excellent documentation, reporting, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and under pressure.

* MCSE – Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert.

Description:
**Job Description**

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
* Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
* Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
* Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
* Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
* Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
* Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
* Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
* Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
* Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.
* Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, analytics teams, product owners, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business outcomes and enterprise standards.
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices, documentation standards, stakeholder communications, and operational processes.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Project Analyst, or in a similar role supporting data, software, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience working with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, reporting, data integration, or related enterprise technology.
* Experience supporting complex technology change, migration, modernization, or transformation initiatives, including coordination across multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong documentation skills, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, meeting outcomes, decisions, and status reporting.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and delivery tracking.
* Ability to understand and communicate data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, business processes, and impacts across upstream and downstream teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, assess impacts, and organize complex information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for business and technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align teams with differing priorities.
* Proficiency with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse or data platform migrations, particularly from on-premises Oracle environments to cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting large-scale or complex migrations involving data, ETL/ELT processes, reports, interfaces, or downstream consumers.
* Experience with data governance, data quality management, metadata, data cataloging, lineage, or master/reference data practices.
* Experience defining migration approach, scope, business impacts, dependencies, readiness criteria, and validation or reconciliation plans.
* Familiarity with SQL and the ability to review queries, data structures, mappings, and reconciliation results.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, defect triage, business sign-off, and post-release validation.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with formal security, privacy, risk, or change-management practices.
Familiarity with tools such as Lucidchart, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent requirements and process-mapping tools.
