Title: Global Security Operations Centre Operator
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.
* Deliver professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy, ensuring the highest standards of quality and service.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.
* Ensure proper case handover between shifts, maintaining continuity of operations.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

  ###
* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Risk and Crisis Management experience.
  + Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.
  + Experience of working in a customer/client-focused role.

---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training) in a field related to security, risk management, international politics or international relations.
* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor
Description:
**About The Role**
**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor in Doha, Qatar.**
A prominent member of the GSOC, the Supervisor will act as a go-to-person for the Security Operator and will report to the GSOC Manager.
  
  
The GSOC Supervisor will review and monitor the tasks of the GSOC Operator and provide necessary guidance and support, as required by the GSOC Operator. The GSOC Supervisor will facilitate the timely delivery of high-quality security risk advice, will communicate with different internal stakeholders and will incorporate feedback from QatarEnergy into the day-to-day operations of the GSOC.
  
  
The GSOC Supervisor will also support security assessments relating to new and emerging market entry, conduct baseline threat monitoring and collate security risk information. The role will contribute to functional enhancement projects, support the identification and communication of security events affecting business travellers, and provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises.
  
  
Additionally, the GSOC Supervisor will work closely with the GSOC Manager and the GSOC Operator in updating relevant operational processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Core Support to QatarEnergy**

* Support operational planning and readiness through the maintenance and development of security provider networks and the preparation of Concepts of Operations.
* Participate in projects relating to functional enhancements to ensure QatarEnergy maintains best-in-class security assistance capabilities.
* Ensure client awareness of the current security environment in countries across the region of responsibility.
* Travel, as required, to countries within the region to assess the security situation, evaluate local provider capabilities and expand the existing network of security contacts to support clients and operational planning.
* Support new and emerging market entry assessments by conducting baseline threat monitoring and collating relevant security risk information.
* Identify and communicate high-impact, time-sensitive security events to business travellers and internal stakeholders.
* Provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises, escalating requests for assistance to the GSOC Manager, QatarEnergy Senior Leadership and International SOS Assistance Centre, as appropriate.
* Work closely with the GSOC Manager and GSOC Operator to review and update operational processes.

**Global Threat Monitoring**

* Oversee and validate threat monitoring conducted by Operators to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Conduct baseline and enhanced threat assessments, including for new and emerging markets.
* Collate and analyse security risk data to support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Ensure timely escalation of high-impact or time-sensitive threats to stakeholders and leadership.

**Travel Security Risk Management**

* Supervise the delivery of travel security advice, ensuring consistency with client requirements and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Support the identification and communication of destination-specific risks to business travellers and stakeholders.
* Review incident tracking and reporting to ensure quality, accuracy and completeness.
* Facilitate coordination with internal stakeholders and external assistance providers, where required.

**Crisis & Emergency Management**

* Act as the primary escalation point for Operators during incidents and crises.
* Provide preliminary crisis assessments and security advice to stakeholders.
* Coordinate GSOC response activities and ensure effective information flow during incidents.
* Escalate critical situations to the GSOC Manager, senior leadership and external support entities, as required.
* Support updates and improvements to operational processes and crisis response frameworks

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse operational environments.
* Demonstrated experience in security risk monitoring, intelligence analysis and incident assessment.
* Good understanding of the geopolitical and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Ability to review, validate and enhance intelligence outputs and risk assessments produced by Operators.
* Proficiency in coordinating security assistance tasks, including travel risk management and incident response.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey security risks and advice to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to analyse multiple streams of security, threat and logistical information under time pressure and provide actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with GSOC operations, escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks.
* Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and relevant operational platforms.

**Required Work Experience**

* Typically, 5–7 years’ experience in security risk management, intelligence analysis or GSOC operations within military, government, NGO or private sector roles.
* Experience in monitoring global threats and providing security risk assessments.
* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Educated to a degree level (or equivalent professional training and experience) in security studies, risk management, international relations, political science or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in security or risk management (desirable).

Required Languages
  
  

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Additional language skills (Arabic, French, etc.) desirable.

Title: Project Engineer - Controls Systems
Description:
### **What You Will Do**

The Project Engineer - Controls will report directly to the Branch Manager and will be based in Qatar. As part of the Controls & Building Automation Systems (BAS) team, you will be responsible for the engineering, design review, project execution, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of Building Management System (BMS) and Integrated Controls projects across multiple client sites.

You will work closely with customers, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications and company standards. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop advanced technical, project management, and customer engagement skills within a dynamic environment.

### **How You Will Do It**

As a Project Engineer - Controls, you will leverage your technical expertise in BMS and Building Automation Systems to support all phases of project execution, from engineering and design review through commissioning and handover.

You will:

* Execute BMS, HVAC Controls, and Building Automation projects in accordance with project schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Review project specifications, drawings, sequences of operation, and control schematics to ensure compliance with client and consultant requirements.
* Prepare engineering submittals, technical documentation, method statements, and project reports.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to facilitate smooth project execution and timely issue resolution.
* Configure, program, and commission BMS controllers, supervisory systems, field devices, and network integrations.
* Perform functional testing, point-to-point verification, system integration, and site acceptance testing.
* Provide technical support during installation, startup, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, delays, and technical challenges, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with project quality requirements, company procedures, and HSE standards throughout project execution.
* Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure adherence to project schedules and delivery milestones.
* Assist in project planning, resource allocation, procurement coordination, and material management activities.
* Support project closeout activities, including preparation of as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training, and client handover.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain effective communication with all project stakeholders.

### **What We Look For**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Engineering.
* Minimum 5-6 years of experience in the design, engineering, execution, or commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), or Controls projects.
* Proven experience in HVAC controls, chiller plant controls, energy management systems, and building automation applications.
* Strong understanding of control system architectures, field devices, communication protocols, and system integrations including BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and TCP/IP networking.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, specifications, and technical submittals.
* Experience in system programming, controller configuration, graphics development, and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of project execution methodologies, risk management, and quality control processes.
* Strong understanding of project documentation, contractual requirements, and client communications.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

Title: Provider Operations Specialist
Description:
**Build better healthcare together**

Maple’s purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We’re Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we’re proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what’s possible every day.

Bold minds. Big impact. A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you’ll do work that changes lives—including your own.

### **The role**

As a Provider Operations Specialist, you'll help keep Maple's provider network running smoothly across three areas: Provider Success, Network Performance, and Process Operations.

You'll support everything from provider onboarding and billing to platform updates, performance monitoring, and internal team coordination. You'll work with teams across Maple to solve problems, keep day-to-day operations on track, and find ways to make our processes simpler and more efficient.

### **Your responsibilities**

As a Provider Operations Specialist, you'll:

* Respond to provider questions and resolve operational issues promptly.
* Coordinate provider onboarding to ensure a smooth experience from start to finish.
* Coordinate provider communications, ensuring providers have the information and support they need.
* Support platform setup and configuration, including updates to specialties, provider segments, and product features.
* Support platform testing and quality assurance to ensure everything works as intended.
* Support provider billing and payment processes.
* Coordinate administrative activities related to provider complaints.
* Track regulatory updates and support recurring operational processes.
* Act as a point of contact for internal teams, handling routine requests through channels like Slack and escalating more complex issues.
* Contribute to maintaining team documentation, trackers, procedures, and knowledge base resources to keep information accurate and up to date.
* Contribute to identifying ways to simplify and improve workflows.

### **What success looks like**

**In your first 90 days, you'll:**

* Build strong relationships with your team and key partners while learning Maple's systems, workflows, and provider network operations.
* Get comfortable supporting day-to-day activities across Provider Success, Network Performance, Process Operations, and Team Administration.
* Start handling provider and internal support requests, onboarding activities, billing tasks, and other recurring processes with increasing independence.

**In 12–18 months, you'll:**

* Be a trusted resource for providers and internal teams, independently owning a wide range of operational tasks and knowing when to escalate issues.
* Take ownership of recurring processes across billing, onboarding, reporting, platform configuration, and team coordination.
* Contribute to identifying ways to simplify and improve workflows, helping the team work more efficiently and deliver a better provider experience.

### **What you bring**

* An undergraduate degree in business, commerce, health administration, communications or a related field, with 2+ years of experience in an operations support role or similar.
* Foundational experience conducting varied operational work and following established processes to resolve routine issues.
* Strong organization — you can work on multiple workstreams carefully, keep moving parts on track and maintain accurate records.
* A proactive communication style — you keep partners informed, flag issues early and make it easy for the team to know where things stand.
* Strong written communication skills — you can respond to inbound inquiries clearly, warmly and professionally.
* Strong prioritization and problem-solving skills — you can balance recurring work with ad-hoc requests, resolve what you can and know when to escalate.
* A collaborative, service-oriented mindset — you enjoy connecting people, teams and work streams.
* Comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently — you look for opportunities to simplify tasks, improve workflows and make everyday work easier.

Play to your strengths. Finding the right fit goes both ways—so this section is yours to complete. When you join, you'll add the unique strengths you bring that aren't captured above.

### **How we'll support you**

We recognise our people's health is everything. That's why we take care of them.

* **Maple for you and your family:** 24/7 access to general practitioners, pediatrics and mental health therapy for you and your family. Care starts on day one
* **Comprehensive health coverage:** Medical, dental and life insurance because your peace of mind—and your loved ones—matter most
* **Health spending account:** Extra funds to cover the essentials that make a difference, from new glasses to specialised therapy
* **Flex benefits:** An annual budget built for your growth and well-being. Use it for professional development, wellness expenses or a one-time boost to your retirement savings. You choose what matters most
* **Health days:** Life happens. We provide 10 dedicated days for rest, medical appointments or caregiving, so you can show up at your best
* **Destination days:** Work from anywhere. Enjoy the flexibility to work internationally in eligible countries for up to five days per year
* **Group retirement savings plan:** We're here for the long haul. Invest in your future with our group retirement plan

### **The details**

* **Job type:** New role, full-time
* **Hiring manager:** Manager, Provider Network Operations
* **Location:** Hybrid, 500 King Street West, Toronto
* **Start date:** December 2026
* **Vacation:** 3 weeks
* **Pay range:** $56,000 – $63,000

Offers can vary depending on skills, experience and readiness to meet Maple's expectations for this level. We encourage open conversations about pay. If you have questions about how compensation works at Maple, you're welcome to ask at any point in the interview process.

Title: Care Management Specialist
Description:
As a Care Management Specialist, you’ll play an important role in making sure each resident’s needs are accurately assessed, documented, and reflected in their plan of care. Your work helps our interdisciplinary team understand changes in residents’ health and functional status while ensuring we meet important Medicare and Medicaid requirements.

This is a role where clinical knowledge, attention to detail, and teamwork directly impact resident care and the organization’s ability to provide the services our residents need. From completing MDS assessments and supporting care planning to monitoring reimbursement requirements and serving as a resource to facility staff, you’ll help connect clinical care, compliance, and operational success.

Wellsential Health is the largest Texas-based non-profit, skilled nursing organization, representing more than 65 skilled nursing and rehabilitation centers across the state. Our mission is to make better health and wellness possible for all Texans by delivering compassionate, high-quality care in the communities we serve. As a non-profit partner, we reinvest in our residents, our facilities, and our people—because our purpose is care, not profit.

Our team members are dedicated professionals who bring heart, integrity, and commitment to improving quality of life every day. At Wellsential Health, we believe caring for our team is just as important as caring for our residents. When our team members feel supported, valued, and well cared for, they can provide the highest level of care in return. If you’re looking for meaningful work where you can make a lasting impact, Wellsential Health is the place to grow your career and serve with purpose.

* Assess residents’ health and functional status accurately and on time throughout their stay.
* Participate in pre-admissions to collect essential information for MDS/Case Mix optimization.
* Complete all Medicare/Medicaid case-mix documents promptly to ensure correct reimbursement.
* Collaborate with the Director of Rehab to use the appropriate assessment reference dates.
* Track Medicare/Managed Care eligibility and benefits through regular communication with care managers.
* Provide necessary information for Managed Care Utilization Reviews.
* Ensure compliance with Medicare requirements, including physician certification and recertification.
* Review MDS data concurrently to support appropriate RUG categorization.
* Collaborate with the interdisciplinary team on care planning and status changes.
* Complete all MDS assessments (Admission, Quarterly, Annual, PPS, Significant Change) according to RAI guidelines.
* Maintain an accurate MDS schedule and monitor for default or missed assessments, implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Perform assessment modifications/inactivations per CMS policy.
* Conduct regular audits of MDS processes and documentation accuracy.
* Ensure timely electronic submission of all MDS assessments and validate reports.
* Review QM and SNF QRP reports and take follow-up actions as required.
* Communicate with the Business Office and Administrator regarding case mix, RUG distribution, and reimbursement impact.
* Participate in Case Management, Level of Care, Triple Check, and other policy meetings.
* Support ADRs, Reconsiderations, and ALJ submissions as needed.
* Serve as a resource on RAI and Care Management for staff, including training new associates.
* Maintain knowledge of reimbursement regulations and organize department data efficiently.
* Demonstrate strong clinical assessment and documentation skills and support flexible business needs.
* Complete all MDS/RUGs training (AIS) within the first 90 days and ongoing as required

* Graduate of an accredited school of nursing with a current Texas R.N. or L.V.N. license
* Proficient with standard office software and MDS/RAI-related applications.
* Preferred experience with Point Click Care EMR software
* Strong initiative and ability to lead interdisciplinary teams and manage the RAI process efficiently
* Minimum of 2 years of healthcare experience
* Experience in MDS completion, reimbursement, clinical resource utilization, and/or case management is preferred

When the unexpected happens, are you ready to make that critical call which keeps the network moving?

window, under the operational control of the IOCC Shift Manager and day-to-day guidance of the Senior Operations Controller.

**Hourly/Non-Exempt/Part-time**

**Title**: Program Facilitator – ILS MB

**Reports to**: Independent Living Skills Program Manager

**Schedule:**

Foundations for Independent Living - Tue/Thur 10:15 am-3:15pm (21st Ave)

Virtual Class – Tue/Thur 8:30am-9:30am, Fri 10am-11am

Create and maintain professional relationships with participants, families, staff, interns, volunteers, and community partners.

Working knowledge and experience in health education would helpful.

Multitasking and attention to details are a must.

Patience, good communication, both written and orally are essential.

Title: Program Support Specialist, FAHCS (Part-Time Temporary)
Description:
The Program Support Specialist (PSS) provides front-line administrative, organizational, and operational support to students, Associate Deans (ADs), faculty, faculty administrators, and program coordinators within the Faculty of Applied Health and Community Studies (FAHCS).

Reporting to the Senior Manager, FAHCS Finance and Administration, the incumbent provides front-line student service and administrative support, primarily at the Davis H Wing office. The role serves as a first point of contact for students, faculty, and staff, responding to general enquiries and directing requests to the appropriate resources.

The PSS also provides financial and administrative support to the Faculty, including purchasing, expense tracking, budget monitoring, financial documentation, and general office coordination. Working collaboratively with PSS colleagues across the five schools, the incumbent helps maintain consistent service delivery and administrative continuity across FAHCS locations, including Davis and HMC, based on operational needs and student demand.

Given the confidential nature of the information handled, the incumbent must exercise discretion and adhere to Sheridan policies, including Privacy, and applicable legislation, including the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FIPPA).

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Providing front-line reception and administrative support at the Davis H Wing office, responding to student, faculty, and staff enquiries in person, by telephone, and by email.
* Directing enquiries to the appropriate faculty, program coordinator or department and following up as required.
* Supporting appointment scheduling, room bookings, meeting coordination, and general office administration.
* Assisting with student service during peak periods, including the beginning of term and periods of increased enrolment.
* Supporting other FAHCS locations, including HMC, based on operational needs.
* Assisting the Senior Manager with financial administration, including expenditure tracking, budget monitoring, and maintaining accurate financial records.
* Processing purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and invoices through the PeopleSoft.
* Assisting with preliminary account reconciliations and identifying discrepancies or missing documentation for follow-up.
* Maintaining financial tracking spreadsheets and preparing expenditure summaries to support budget monitoring and reporting.
* Following up with schools and college departments regarding outstanding financial transactions and documentation.
* Ordering office and instructional supplies through approved purchasing processes.
* Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of program documentation, including program maps, course outlines, curriculum changes, and program review materials.
* Supporting meeting coordination, agenda preparation, minute-taking, and documentation for school and Faculty meetings, including Program Advisory Committees (PACs).
* Assisting with the coordination of Faculty projects, events, and other administrative activities.
* Maintaining accurate electronic and paper filing systems and ensuring records are current and accessible to authorized staff.
* Working collaboratively with PSS colleagues across the five schools to support consistent service delivery and administrative coverage.
* Monitoring and documenting student enquiries and service demand, including through QR code tracking, to support operational planning.
* Performing other related duties as assigned.

You have the skills and knowledge to work with an increasingly diverse student and staff population as well as a proven commitment to **anti-oppression, equity, and inclusion**.

You demonstrate excellent **judgement, initiative**, and your **creative problem-solving skills** allow you to solve challenges in a creative way.

You enjoy balancing many different tasks and can **prioritize** multiple projects while staying organized and maintaining a high level of attention to detail.

You have excellent **interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills** and enjoy working as part of a team in a **fast-paced environment**.

* 3-year diploma/degree in Business Administration (or a related field), along with a minimum of 3 years of experience in customer service or office administration (or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience).
* Skills in research, collection and synthesis of written and verbal data is necessary.
* Advanced level of computer software skills is required (e.g., Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, PeopleSoft Financial, database management, internet research, Outlook).
* Highly independent, resourceful, solutions-focused, and proactive.

Title: People Operations Advisor
Description:
Reporting to the Manager, Human Resources Business Excellence, the People Operations Advisor provides centralized, first-contact Human Resources service and operational support to employees and leaders across Sheridan College within a shared services environment. The role is responsible for accurate intake, triage, and resolution of all HR inquiries across the employee lifecycle including providing integrated operational support spanning compensation, payroll-adjacent inquiries, benefits, pension, labour relations intake, workplace abilities intake, learning administration and HR systems support, while ensuring the integrity, confidentiality, and quality of HR data, records, and transactions. The Advisor supports payroll accuracy through proactive audits, issue investigation, and timely resolution. Lastly, the Advisor contributes to continuous improvement by identifying service trends, maintaining knowledge resources, and supporting enhancements to HR process, workflows, and systems.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Managing HR inquiries through ServiceNow, shared inboxes, and phone, including logging, tracking, updating, and closing cases in accordance with established procedures and service standards;
* Routing and escalating complex or specialized inquiries to the appropriate HR Centres of Expertise or partner teams;
* Investigating non-routine HR issues, identifying discrepancies across systems and records, determining root causes, and coordinating corrective actions with appropriate partners;
* Providing guidance to employees and leaders on HR processes, policies, and procedures related to recruitment, onboarding, job changes, leaves, benefits, pay administration, and terminations;
* Processing and coordinating HR transactions, including employee and job data changes, reporting structure updates, contract loading, step and status changes, employee ID creation, compensation updates, and terminations;
* Maintaining employee records and supporting documentation across HR systems and digital files, ensuring completeness, audit readiness, and compliance with legislative and College requirements;
* Preparing routine and ad hoc HR reports and data extracts to support workforce planning, analytics, dashboards, and union-related requests;
* Conducting bi-weekly and monthly HR/payroll data audits ahead of payroll deadlines, investigating discrepancies, and coordinating resolutions with Payroll and HR partners;
* Developing and updating HR knowledge articles, templates, and intake forms to support consistent and efficient service delivery;
* Recommending improvements to HR processes and service delivery based on case trends, transaction patterns, and audit findings;
* Contributing to process redesign, system testing, and service enhancements by providing operational expertise and identifying opportunities for improvement;
* Supporting the implementation of HR process and system changes by validating requirements, assessing operational impacts, and assisting with testing and adoption;
* Performing other related duties and supporting projects and initiatives as required.

**About You**

You are committed to delivering **exceptional client service**, responding to inquiries professionally, efficiently, and with a **solutions-focused approach**.

You possess excellent **written** and verbal **communication** skills, with the ability to convey information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

You bring strong **research**, **analytical**, and **problem-solving** skills, with the ability to assess complex situations, identify discrepancies, and develop practical solutions.  
You demonstrate exceptional **attention to detail** and **accuracy**, with experience creating spreadsheets, **analyzing data**, and preparing reports.

You exercise **sound judgment** and **discretion** when handling sensitive and confidential information.

You have excellent **organizational** and **time management** skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

You demonstrate **initiative** and **independence** while working collaboratively and contributing to team goals.

You possess strong **interpersonal** and **diplomatic** skills, with the ability to navigate sensitive situations, manage expectations, and build positive relationships with employees, managers, and stakeholders.  
  
**The ideal candidate will also possess the following qualifications:**

* 3-year diploma/degree in Human Resources Management or related field; Public sector or post-secondary HR specialization (preferred)
* 3 years of progressive experience in HR operations, HR shared services, or HR service delivery, including experience responding to employee and leader inquiries, administering HR processes and transactions across the employee lifecycle, maintaining HR records and data, and resolving HR-related issues (equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered)
* Knowledge of and/or experience with HR service delivery models and case management practices
* Experience processing HRIS transaction and data integrity controls
* Experience with HR practices, pension and benefit plans and business requirements
* Ability to work with high volumes of data (e.g. for reporting, analysis and correction of data issues)
* Knowledge of Employment Standards Act, Human Rights Code, Freedom of Information etc.
* Working knowledge of HR operations in a unionized environment, including employee lifecycle transactions, payroll dependencies, collective agreement application, benefit and pension administration, records management, and HR data governance
* Solid understanding of how HR transactions and data changes affect downstream payroll, reporting, compliance, and employee service outcomes
* Computer proficiency (Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, MS Office (Advanced Excel, in particular)

* Experience with collective agreement administration
* Experience with employment legislation and HR policies

Title: Project Engineering Management, Sr Staff Engineer
Description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the integrated execution strategy and critical path across multiple interdependent Memory Interface IP development and release workstreams. Establish the planning methodology, dependency model, milestone architecture, and operating cadence needed to manage programs from architecture and project kickoff through design closure, verification, customer delivery, and production readiness.
* Independently evaluate schedule scenarios and drive recovery strategies. Understand dependency chains, technical constraints, resource limitations, and available float deeply enough to quantify the impact of slips, pull-ins, and changing priorities. Develop options, recommend the appropriate response, and drive agreement on the recovery path.
* Drive cross-functional program decisions, not simply project status. Synthesize evidence from architecture, RTL, design verification, analog and mixed-signal design, physical design, packaging, software, infrastructure, product engineering, and post-silicon teams to identify emerging constraints, expose unsupported assumptions, and frame decisions before downstream commitments are affected.
* Use verification convergence and engineering maturity as leading indicators. Evaluate feature readiness, RTL closure, bug discovery and closure trends, regression health, coverage, design maturity, and block-level readiness to determine whether execution is converging toward program milestones. Challenge recovery assumptions when the engineering data does not support the plan.
* Lead complex external dependencies and negotiations across R&D teams and customers. Align delivery calendars and acceptance criteria, evaluate schedule and technical trade-offs, and negotiate agreements with a clear understanding of downstream program and business consequences.
* Resolve ambiguous cross-functional problems where technical, schedule, resource, quality, and customer objectives compete. Establish decision criteria, evaluate alternatives, clarify accountability, and facilitate timely decisions at the appropriate leadership level.
* Shape and improve the program operating model. Identify opportunities to strengthen integrated planning, dependency analysis, risk management, milestone readiness, engineering dashboards, and decision governance. Drive adoption of effective practices across related programs and teams.
* Provide executive-level program insight. Distill complex engineering information into the trends, trade-offs, business impacts, and decisions that matter most. Present evidence-based recommendations rather than simply escalating problems.
* Coach and mentor other project managers and engineering contributors in integrated planning, dependency modeling, risk management, stakeholder communication, and disciplined program execution. Provide constructive review and help build consistent execution capability across the organization.

A Day In The Life
  
  
You start the morning reviewing verification and schedule trends across several interdependent workstreams. Individual milestones still appear achievable, but you identify that slower verification convergence combined with an external dependency is eliminating critical-path margin several weeks downstream. Rather than waiting for the milestone to become at risk, you bring the relevant engineering leads together, challenge the assumptions behind the existing recovery plan, and model alternative execution scenarios.
  
  
You recommend a sequencing and resource change that protects the highest-priority customer commitment while containing the impact elsewhere. During the project review, you walk leadership through the evidence, explain the technical and business trade-offs, and drive agreement on the path forward. Later, you work with another project manger to strengthen dependency modeling on a related program and meet with infrastructure leadership to address a compute-capacity constraint that could affect multiple projects.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Applied Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor, silicon IP, SoC, ASIC, or complex hardware development. An advanced degree with 6+ years of related experience may also be considered.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, highly interdependent semiconductor or silicon IP programs across multiple engineering disciplines, organizations, and geographic locations.
* Advanced understanding of semiconductor development lifecycles and the ability to independently assess technical maturity, verification convergence, physical-design readiness, infrastructure capacity, external-IP dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with true dependency and critical-path modeling, including float analysis, milestone confidence, scenario planning, and recovery options.
* Proven ability to solve complex program problems requiring in-depth evaluation of technical, organizational, resource, quality, customer, and business factors.
* Strong influence and negotiation skills, with demonstrated ability to gain alignment across engineering organizations, customers, suppliers, and external partners when priorities or objectives conflict.
* Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to distinguish signal from noise, quantify impact, explain trade-offs, and present clear recommendations to VP-level audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to improve program-management methods, operating practices, dashboards, or governance beyond a single project, and experience coaching or mentoring PEMs, project managers, or engineering contributors.
* Proficiency with project and program management tools and data-driven reporting. Experience with Jira, schedule-management tools, dashboards, and engineering lifecycle metrics is preferred.
* Knowledge of quality-management processes and the ability to navigate Linux environments are considered assets.

Who You Are
  
  
This is not a status-reporting role. You will provide program leadership across complex, highly interdependent Memory Interface IP development efforts, connecting engineering workstreams into an integrated execution strategy and establishing the methods, operating cadence, and decision mechanisms needed to keep programs on track. Working with limited supervision, you will determine how complex programs should be planned, monitored, and driven; identify the real critical path; challenge assumptions; evaluate technical, resource, schedule, and business trade-offs; and lead cross-functional decisions that protect customer and business commitments.
  
  
The role requires advanced semiconductor-development knowledge, strong technical judgment, and the influence to align engineering teams, customers, and infrastructure organizations when priorities or objectives compete. You will also strengthen project management practices and coach other project mangers and contributors, raising execution capability beyond a single project.
  
  
The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
Our engineering teams develop advanced Memory Interface IP that enables customers to build high-performance, differentiated SoCs. We work at the intersection of architecture, analog and mixed-signal design, RTL, verification, physical design, software, infrastructure, and customer deployment. The programs are technically complex, globally distributed, and tightly connected to customer and business commitments.
  
  
We value people who combine advanced technical judgment with clear communication, disciplined execution, and the willingness to work through details without losing sight of the broader outcome. In this role, you will help shape how complex semiconductor programs are planned and delivered, strengthen execution practices across teams, and work alongside talented engineers solving consequential problems at scale.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
Synopsys Canada ULC values the diversity of our workforce. We are committed to provide access & opportunity to individuals with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals throughout the recruitment and employment process. Should you require an accommodation, please contact hr-help-canada@synopsys.com.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. ##### **About The Role**

**About the role**
------------------

Peraton seeks a proven cybersecurity operations leader to run a managed security services program for a large federal critical infrastructure customer in the Pacific Northwest. The program defends the customer's corporate and operational technology (OT) networks against nation-state and criminal threats, protects the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of its systems and data, and supports compliance with federal and electric-sector cybersecurity requirements.

As MSSP Manager, you lead the full Peraton team across eight service areas: security assessment, digital forensics and incident response, communications and data analysis, Splunk engineering, tools and infrastructure support, 24x7x365 Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, technology evolution and automation, and surge support. You are Peraton's designated Management Representative and the single point of contact to the customer's Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR). The customer sets objectives and service levels through you. You decide how the work gets done, who does it, and when.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who has run a 24x7 SOC or managed security program, can take over an operation that is already running without a restart, and is comfortable owning contract performance end to end.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Program leadership and contract performance**

* Serve as the Management Representative, with full authority to adjust schedules, reallocate staff across service areas, and commit Peraton to corrective action
* Receive all customer objectives, service level agreements (SLAs), and priorities, and assign the work to service area leads
* Keep Peraton's independent contractor role clear: customer staff set outcomes, Peraton supervises Peraton staff
* Lead development of the SLA matrix with the customer within 30 days of award, and track performance against it
* Own the reporting rhythm: daily operations status, weekly status reports, monthly reports, and quarterly business reviews
* Lead kickoff, the RACI (responsibility) matrix, the communications and escalation matrix, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in the first 90 days
* Track staffing, travel, tools, and contract deliverables against contract requirements

**Security operations**

* Provide direction for 24x7x365 SOC operations, including shift structure, handovers, on-call rotation, and minimum staffing on every shift
* Set and manage SOC performance measures, including mean time to detect, investigate, recover, and resolve (MTTD, MTTI, MTTR)
* Oversee monitoring, analysis, and response using SIEM (Splunk), EDR, SOAR, and related tools, working with a dedicated Splunk architect who owns content and platform engineering
* Oversee the collection and use of log, network flow, packet, context, and threat intelligence data, and recommend new data sources
* Lead escalation of significant incidents, including suspected nation-state activity and events involving federal partners, and coordinate evidence handoff to the customer's forensics team
* Recommend security changes (firewall and IDS/IPS rules, access control lists, patching, certificates, privileged access) through the customer's change management process
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) current as threats and technology change

**People and staffing**

* Lead a team of about 12 to 23 analysts, engineers, assessors, and forensic specialists through service area leads
* Confirm every team member is fully qualified, credentialed, and cleared before they start work
* Run the access lifecycle with the security team: onboarding, badging, required training, regular login checks
* Monitor staff conduct and system use against customer policies, and keep the records
* Manage performance, retention, cross-training, and succession so the team keeps its depth

**Surge, transition, and technology**

* Activate and lead surge support when the customer requests added capacity for major incidents, critical zero-day vulnerabilities, urgent assessments, or audits, without pulling staff from base operations
* Lead transition-in from the current provider, including knowledge transfer and Day 1 readiness, and plan an orderly transition-out
* Guide the responsible use of AI and automation in security operations, with human review of AI output, customer approval before any tool is used, and data kept inside the customer's environment
* Review and approve reports, data call responses, and threat briefings before they go to the customer

##### **Qualifications**

**Required:**
-------------

* U.S. citizenship
* Ability to pass a Public Trust background investigation and a drug screening before start
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE L clearance (an active DOE L or DoD Secret is strongly preferred)
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field
* 12 or more years of cybersecurity experience, including at least 5 years leading a 24x7 SOC, managed security service, or similar operations team
* Active industry cybersecurity certification at start, such as CISSP or CISM
* Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2, NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3, NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, NERC CIP, FedRAMP, FISMA, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* Hands-on understanding of SIEM operations, ideally Splunk, and of incident response and threat analysis
* Experience managing to contract SLAs and deliverables for a government or regulated customer
* Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain technical issues and risk to executives and contracting staff

**Desired:**
------------

* Master's degree in a related field
* Experience with electric utility, energy, or other OT/ICS environments
* Experience with DOE security programs, including facility clearance and personnel security processes
* PMP, or other cybersecurity certifications such as CISM, CISA, GIAC GCIH, GSLC, or CEH
* Experience leading a contract transition for a 24x7 operation
* Experience applying AI or automation in security operations

Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EMS Education Manager**
=========================

**Posting Number:** #2186

**Position Title:** EMS Education Manager

**Closing Date:** Until Filled

**Location:** Remote, USA

  

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.

PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non-Profit Times in a national search.

  

##### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Bridge Center (Bridge) at the Public Health Institute (PHI) works across the health care system to expand access to low-barrier addiction treatment and sexual and reproductive health care, and to advance health equity. Since 2019, CA Bridge has supported more than 290 hospitals to implement medications for addiction treatment (MAT) in the emergency department (ED) based on the CA Bridge model for 24/7 low-barrier access to evidence-based care. Since then, Bridge has trained teams in 22 states, 56 EDs, and 6 EMS agencies. Collectively, they reach 2,181 providers whose EDs see nearly 2.5 million patient visits a year.

EMS Bridge extends low-barrier MAT to paramedics, bringing EMS-initiated buprenorphine to communities across the country, including in California. The National Expansion Project builds capacity for emergency department-based MAT across the country; the ED Syphilis/HIV/HCV Screening Program supports emergency departments in implementing routine opt-out screening and linkage to care; and Access Bridge increases access to contraception and treatment for pregnancy emergencies from the ED.

##### **POSITION OVERVIEW**

Bridge is hiring an EMS Education Manager to work with our EMS Bridge team. EMS Bridge began in California, which remains home to our largest EMS program and much of our ongoing EMS research and implementation work, and now supports EMS agencies in other states. The EMS Education Manager will lead day-to-day planning, coordination, and delivery of EMS Bridge education, training, and technical assistance for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders. Additionally, this role will lead the development and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge curricula, run EMS Bridge learning collaboratives, and support grant reporting on training and technical assistance activities. Strong project management expertise will be necessary in these tasks. The successful candidate will bring direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator and will work with a range of team members and external partners to support EMS agencies to offer buprenorphine and connection to ongoing care for people with opioid use disorder.

The full salary range for this position: $79,333 to $115,098 per year. The typical hiring range for this position is from $79,333 (minimum) to $97,216 (midpoint). The starting salary is determined based on the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and budget availability.

Employment Type: Full Time

##### **Important Information**

* This is a regular full-time 1.0 FTE position with a schedule of 40 hours per week.
* This is a fully remote position that requires travel approximately 30% of the work time, to EMS agency sites, trainings, conferences, and partner meetings as requested, including 2-4 All Staff meetings per year in the San Francisco Bay Area.
* The selected candidate will determine their work schedule in collaboration with their supervisor and is expected to be available during core business hours (9:00am – 2:00pm Pacific Time). Some trainings may be scheduled outside core hours, requiring flexible availability, to reach EMS crews on varied shift schedules.
* This position is open to applicants nationwide.
* **To apply, please submit a resume and cover letter detailing your interest in and qualifications for this position.**

##### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following:**

##### **EMS Training & Technical Assistance**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of trainings for paramedics and EMTs, in person and virtually, including initial buprenorphine trainings, refreshers, case reviews, and scenario-based sessions.
* Translate strategies and priorities established by senior leadership into actionable training and technical assistance plans, activities, resources, and deliverables.
* Design, coordinate, facilitate, and continuously improve EMS Bridge learning collaboratives and communities of practice for participating EMS agencies. This will include:
  + Developing agendas, learning objectives, session plans, facilitation approaches, and supporting materials for collaborative learning activities.
  + Identifying and coordinating Bridge staff, clinical consultants, field providers, and external presenters to contribute to learning collaborative sessions and other educational programming.
  + Incorporating equity and harm reduction content throughout collaborative programming.
  + Fostering opportunities for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators to learn from one another and build professional connections across agencies and regions.
* Partner with EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders to build their capacity to teach EMS Bridge content within their own agencies.
* Provide individualized and group mentorship to field providers and EMS educators participating in Bridge programming, drawing on direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator.
* Assess the training and technical assistance needs of field providers and participating agencies and identify appropriate strategies, resources, and subject matter experts to address those needs.
* Alongside other members of the EMS Bridge team, provide technical assistance related to implementing EMS-initiated buprenorphine, including protocol rollout, field workflows, documentation, patient engagement, crew buy-in and addressing stigma, and handoffs and linkage to care with emergency departments and community treatment programs.
* Identify common themes, challenges, and emerging needs surfaced through trainings, mentorship, and collaborative activities and communicate those findings to Bridge leadership to inform future programming and resource development.
* Identify and disseminate promising practices, tools, resources, and emerging evidence relevant to EMS-initiated buprenorphine and prehospital overdose response.
* Track participation and capture feedback and testimonials from trainings, site visits, and learning collaboratives.
* Represent the Bridge Center’s EMS training and technical assistance work at meetings, trainings, EMS conferences, and other events as requested.

##### **Curriculum & Educational Resource Development**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, support development, adaptation, and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge training curricula and educational resources for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators.
* Develop practical, accessible training materials and resources, including presentations, facilitator guides, case scenarios, skills and simulation activities, job aids, quick-reference tools, and other educational products.
* Collaborate with Bridge clinical experts and other subject matter experts to translate clinical guidance and evidence into practical educational materials for field providers.
* Coordinate subject matter expert review of curricula and resources to ensure materials are accurate, relevant, consistent with Bridge’s approach, and appropriate for EMS audiences.
* Support processes for offering continuing education credit for EMS Bridge trainings, where applicable.
* Incorporate participant feedback, implementation experience, emerging evidence, and changes in the EMS and substance use care landscape into ongoing curriculum and resource improvements.

##### **Project Management & Reporting**

* Manage the day-to-day implementation of assigned EMS training, technical assistance, learning collaborative, and curriculum-development activities from planning through completion.
* Maintain and support the development of project workplans, timelines, milestones, and deliverable trackers to ensure activities remain on schedule.
* Collect and synthesize training attendance, evaluation results, participant feedback, and lessons learned to inform continuous quality improvement.
* Support grant reporting by preparing training and technical assistance data, narratives, and site summaries in line with funder deliverables.
* Collaborate across Bridge teams and projects to identify opportunities to share resources, align programming, reduce duplication, and strengthen the consistency of Bridge training and technical assistance.

Perform other duties as assigned.

##### **QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

##### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Five years’ work experience, including at least one year of experience as a paramedic or EMT, and experience teaching or training others in EMS and/or other clinical settings
* Bachelor’s degree; or high school diploma and an additional four years of relevant work experience, or associate’s degree and an additional two years of relevant work experience.

##### **Other Required Qualifications**

* Knowledge of EMS systems, operations, and culture, and of overdose response and substance use treatment.
* Strong training and presentation skills, and ability to facilitate and engage small and large groups of field providers in dialogue and learning.
* Experience developing training curricula and materials for EMS providers.
* Experience facilitating meetings, learning collaboratives, or communities of practice.
* Understanding of adult learning principles, including scenario-based and simulation learning, and how to embed them in training programs.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Adaptable, flexible, and receptive to feedback.
* Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Lived experience with substance use, or with the communities most affected by substance use and overdose, is valued and strengthens this work.

##### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strongly preferred: EMS instructor credential (e.g., state EMS instructor certification or NAEMSE Instructor).
* Preferred: Experience with buprenorphine or other medications for opioid use disorder in EMS or other clinical settings.

3. Apply E-E-A-T and YMYL principles, medical review and relevant regulatory requirements.

3. Collaborate across performance marketing, CRM, product, engineering, analytics and category teams.

5. App Store Optimisation and mobile app discovery.

3. Search visibility: priority keyword performance, share of search and competitor positioning.

6. Innovation: measurable impact from AI, automation and testing.

3. Analytical, curious and commercially ambitious.  
4. Challenges conventional thinking constructively, backed by data.  
5. Equally comfortable with developers and executive leadership.  
6. Self-starting, action-oriented and enthusiastic about building better ways of working.

**Department:** Customer Care, Operations and Advisory – Call Center  
**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Tameeni is the first authorized online insurance aggregator in Saudi Arabia. Tameeni has transformed the Saudi insurance market through a simple, integrated digital journey that enables customers to compare and issue insurance policies quickly.

Tameeni Health is the first digital health insurance platform serving medium, small, and micro businesses.

#### **Job Summary**

The Head of Call Center will be responsible for leading and managing Tameeni's call center operations, ensuring efficient, accurate, and consistent customer support across insurance products.

The role focuses on operational performance, workforce planning, customer experience, service quality, people leadership, technology enablement, business continuity, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience managing large-scale contact center operations, driving operational improvements, and leading high-performing customer service teams.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Strategy and Operational Management**

* Develop and implement the call center strategy, annual operating plan, budget, and operational improvement roadmap.
* Establish a scalable and efficient operating model aligned with business objectives and customer service requirements.
* Define service levels, staffing requirements, capacity plans, and operational performance standards.
* Develop contingency plans to manage seasonal demand, campaigns, new product launches, system outages, and unexpected increases in call volumes.
* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Operations, Quality, HR, and insurance partners to improve service delivery and customer experience.

#### **Call Center Performance and Workforce Management**

* Oversee daily call center operations, including workforce forecasting, scheduling, queue management, and real-time performance monitoring.
* Monitor and improve key operational metrics, including service level, answer rate, abandonment rate, Average Speed of Answer (ASA), Average Handling Time (AHT), and First Contact Resolution (FCR).

* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, service-level agreements, escalation processes, and operational controls.
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions to improve productivity, efficiency, and service quality.

* Lead and develop call center managers, supervisors, team leaders, and customer service agents.
* Establish clear performance expectations, accountability frameworks, and regular performance review processes.
* Drive employee coaching, recognition, succession planning, and leadership development.
* Address performance challenges through structured improvement plans and continuous feedback.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate training on insurance products, internal systems, customer handling, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Promote a high-performance culture focused on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

* Develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, service quality, and First Contact Resolution.
* Analyze customer complaints, repeat-contact drivers, quality assessments, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Implement root-cause analysis and corrective actions to reduce recurring customer issues.
* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to enhance customer journeys and reduce customer effort.
* Establish quality monitoring and service improvement initiatives across the call center.

* Collaborate with Technology and Operations teams to enhance call center systems, including CRM, IVR, call routing, workforce management, and quality monitoring platforms.

* Ensure compliance with Insurance Authority regulations, internal policies, information security, and data privacy requirements.
